screening_results.reason: This study meets all required inclusion criteria for the bvFTD imaging meta-analysis. It used voxel-based morphometry (VBM) as the imaging modality and reports whole-brain, voxelwise group contrasts. The paper includes an autopsy-confirmed/biomarker-negative behavioural variant FTD (bvFTD) patient group (n=59) and matched control group (n=61), satisfying sample-size requirements. The manuscript reports whole-brain group-level VBM results for bvFTD versus controls and indicates that peak coordinates (local maxima with anatomical labels, T-values, P-values and cluster sizes) are provided in Supplementary Table 1, satisfying the requirement for reported MNI/Talairach coordinates. Full text (methods, results, figures, discussion) is present and the supplement is referenced for coordinates. No exclusion criteria are met.

This study includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients (n=8) and CN and AD control groups, uses FDG-PET and reports voxel-wise, whole-brain SPM/BPM group comparisons normalized to MNI space. However, the full text does not report any peak coordinates (x,y,z) for bvFTD-versus-control voxelwise contrasts (no tables or figure captions with coordinates are provided here). Inclusion criteria met: I3 (FDG-PET used), I4 (bvFTD participants included), I5 (patient and control group sizes ≥6), I6 (between-group contrasts in stereotactic space), I7 (whole-brain voxelwise group results). Inclusion criterion not met: I8 (no peak coordinates reported). No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) apply. Full text appears complete (fulltext_incomplete=false). Therefore exclude because it fails I8 (coordinates).

This study meets all inclusion criteria: it uses FDG-PET and voxel-based morphometry (VBM) (I3); includes a clinically defined bvFTD sample (predementia patients who converted to probable bvFTD) (I4); has adequate sample sizes (25 patients, 20 controls) (I5); reports voxelwise between-group SPM contrasts comparing bvFTD groups to controls in a defined space with Talairach coordinates (I6); provides whole-brain, group-level voxelwise results for the target bvFTD group (I7); and reports peak coordinates (referenced Tables 5 and 6 with Talairach coordinates) (I8). The full text includes methods, results, and discussion and appears complete. No exclusion criteria are met.

Full text appears complete. Study meets inclusion criteria I3 (uses resting-state fMRI), I4 (includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD group, n=15), I5 (bvFTD group n=15; control group n=15), I6 (reports between-group contrasts comparing bvFTD vs controls in Talairach space), and I7 (reports group-level whole-brain voxelwise analyses). HOWEVER it does NOT meet I8: the provided full text does not report any peak coordinates (x,y,z in MNI or Talairach) for bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrasts—results are described by brain regions and cluster summaries only. No exclusion criteria are met. Because I8 is mandatory, the study must be excluded.

This study includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD cases (n=64) and has adequate group sizes, but it does not meet the review's imaging-analysis requirements. The primary imaging approach is automated volumetric region segmentation; voxel-based morphometry (VBM) is used only as an exploratory cluster analysis step. The paper does not report any whole-brain, voxelwise bvFTD-versus-control contrasts with peak coordinates in MNI or Talairach space. Therefore it fails the required criteria for (a) the needed imaging/analysis reporting (I3/I6/I7/I8) despite meeting sample criteria (I4,I5). Full text appears complete.

The study uses resting-state fMRI and VBM and includes a well-defined bvFTD sample (21 patients) with matched controls and reports whole-brain voxelwise group contrasts in MNI space. However, the provided full text does not report any PEAK COORDINATES (x,y,z) for bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrasts; only seed MNI coordinates and figures are given. Because inclusion criterion I8 (reporting peak coordinates for at least one whole-brain bvFTD-versus-control contrast) is not satisfied, the study must be excluded. Full text appears complete (methods/results/discussion present) but coordinate tables or peak coordinates for contrasts are absent in the supplied content.

The study uses voxel-based morphometry (VBM) and reports voxel-wise group analyses; it includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group (n=19) and healthy controls (n=20) and performs between-group voxelwise contrasts. However, the provided full text does not report any explicit peak coordinates (MNI or Talairach x,y,z) for any bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (VBM used), I4 (bvFTD sample included), I5 (sufficient sample sizes), I6 (between-group contrasts performed), I7 (whole-brain voxelwise results for patient groups are described). Inclusion criterion I8 (reporting of peak coordinates for at least one whole-brain bvFTD vs control contrast) is not satisfied in the provided text. No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) apply. Therefore the study must be excluded from the meta-analysis because it fails to provide the required peak coordinate data (I8).

The study uses voxel-based morphometry and reports whole-brain voxelwise W-score maps comparing bvFTD patients to controls (I3, I6, I7). The sample consists of clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients with >6 subjects (n=117; imaging n=82), and control comparisons are described (I4, I5). However, the provided full text does not report any peak coordinates (x,y,z in MNI or Talairach space) for a bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast, nor an explicit table of coordinates in the main text; I8 is not satisfied. No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) are met based on the available text. Therefore the paper must be excluded from the coordinate-based meta-analysis for failing to provide peak coordinates required by I8.

This study meets several inclusion criteria: I3 (uses VBM as an imaging modality), I4 (includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group), I5 (bvFTD n=21 and controls n=20, both ≥6), I6 (reports between-group VBM contrasts of bvFTD vs controls in MNI-normalized space), and I7 (provides whole-brain, group-level voxelwise VBM results for the bvFTD group). However, the provided full text does NOT report any peak coordinates (x,y,z) for bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrasts in the main text. Although figures and supplementary tables are referenced, no explicit coordinates are present in the supplied content. Because inclusion criterion I8 (reporting of peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space for at least one whole-brain bvFTD vs control contrast) is not satisfied in the provided full text, the study cannot be included. No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) are triggered by the available information. If peak coordinates exist only in supplementary material not provided here, re-screening with that supplement could change this decision.

Although this is an empirical VBM study of FTD that includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group and healthy controls and reports whole-brain voxelwise group contrasts, the provided full text does not include any explicit peak coordinates (x,y,z in MNI or Talairach space) for a bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (VBM), I4 (bvFTD patients included), I5 (sample sizes ≥6), I6 (between-group voxelwise contrasts reported), I7 (whole-brain group-level voxelwise analyses reported). Inclusion criteria not met: I8 (no explicit peak coordinates found in the provided text). No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) are triggered. Because I8 is not satisfied, the study cannot be included for coordinate-based meta-analysis based on the provided materials.

The study uses VBM and reports neuroanatomical correlations in a bvFTD sample, but it does NOT provide an unrestricted whole-brain bvFTD-versus-control voxelwise contrast with peak coordinates. Instead, the imaging analysis reports within-patient VBM regressions (valence difference correlations) and the VBM was masked to a pre-defined reward-circuit mask. Therefore it fails the requirement for a between-group whole-brain contrast with coordinates. Exclusion rationale: analyses are mask-constrained (ROI/masked VBM), and no whole-brain bvFTD>control contrast with MNI/Talairach peak coordinates is reported. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (VBM used), I4 (clinically diagnosed bvFTD sample), I5 (sample sizes: 25 bvFTD, 21 controls). Inclusion criteria NOT met: I6 (no between-group bvFTD vs control contrast reported), I7 (no whole-brain, unrestricted voxelwise group-level result for bvFTD vs controls), I8 (no peak coordinates for a bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast provided in the text). Exclusion criteria met: E6 (results rely on a masked/ROI voxelwise analysis). Full text appears complete for screening (methods, results, discussion present).

This study is excluded because it does not use the required imaging modalities or report whole-brain voxelwise coordinates. Inclusion criteria met: I4 (patients clinically diagnosed with probable bvFTD) and I5 (patient sample n=75 ≥6). Inclusion criteria not met: I3 (did not use VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET; used visual MRI assessment), I6 (no between-group voxelwise contrast in MNI/Talairach space reported vs controls), I7 (no whole-brain voxelwise group-level result for bvFTD-versus-control), I8 (no peak coordinates reported). No exclusion criteria from the list (E5–E9) were triggered. Full text appears complete (introduction, methods, results, discussion). Therefore the paper does not provide the imaging data required for the meta-analysis and must be excluded.

Exclusion reason: This is a structural MRI study using region-aggregated cortical volumes/thickness (FreeSurfer ROI composites) rather than VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET and it does not report whole-brain voxelwise contrasts or stereotactic peak coordinates. (a) Exclusion criteria met: E6 (results derived from ROI/aggregated regional measures, no unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise result) and E9 (study reports cortical thickness/volume methods rather than VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET). (b) Inclusion criteria met: I4 (clinically diagnosed bvFTD sample) and I5 (sample sizes >6: Part A n=18, Part B n=24). (c) Inclusion criteria NOT met: I3 (required imaging modalities: VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET), I6 (no between-group bvFTD-versus-control voxelwise contrast reported), I7 (no whole-brain group-level voxelwise result), and I8 (no peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space reported). Full text appears complete (methods, results, discussion present). Therefore exclude.

This study is excluded because it does not report a bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain voxelwise contrast with peak coordinates. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (used voxel-based morphometry), I4 (included clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients, n=11), I5 (bvFTD group ≥6 participants and control group ≥6). Inclusion criteria not met: I6 (no between-group contrast reported that compares the bvFTD group directly to controls — VBM analyses reported were correlational associations across the combined patient cohort rather than bvFTD-versus-control contrasts), I7 (no clear group-level, whole-brain voxelwise result identified as coming from the bvFTD target group), I8 (no peak coordinates for a bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast are provided in the text). Exclusion criteria met: none ([]). Full text appears complete (fulltext_incomplete=false).

This study meets all imaging and sample criteria: it uses voxelwise grey-matter density analyses (VBM-style voxelwise GM analyses) comparing clinically-diagnosed bvFTD patients (N=63) to healthy controls (N=55), thus satisfying I3, I4 and I5. The paper reports whole-brain, group-level voxelwise contrasts of bvFTD versus controls (I6 and I7) and refers to peak voxel loci with MNI-to-Talairach conversion (Table 3 and accompanying text), indicating reported peak coordinates for at least one whole-brain contrast (I8). No exclusion criteria are met (not a review, not ROI-only, not an excluded modality). Full text contains Introduction, Methods, Results, and Discussion; core analytic details and imaging results are present. Therefore INCLUDE.

No exclusion criteria met. Inclusion criteria satisfied: I3 (VBM was used), I4 (clinically diagnosed bvFTD group present with 19 bvFTD cases), I5 (patient and control groups both exceed n=6), and I7 (the paper reports group-level whole-brain voxelwise VBM results identified within syndromic groups). Inclusion criteria NOT satisfied: I6 and I8. The manuscript does not report any between-group, whole-brain voxelwise contrast of bvFTD versus healthy controls; instead it reports within-patient-group VBM regression analyses (associations of grey matter with emotion-identification and EMG reactivity) and presents peak coordinates for those correlational maps. It does not provide a bvFTD-versus-control voxelwise contrast with peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space, so the required between-group contrast and associated peak coordinates are absent. Full text appears complete (introduction, methods, results, discussion present).

Exclusion reason: E6 applies. This study used automated segmentation of the thalamus on T1-weighted MRI and reports regional (whole-thalamus) volumetric comparisons rather than an unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise analysis; results are per-region averages, not voxelwise coordinates. Inclusion criteria met: I4 (bvFTD patients are included among clinical subgroups) and I5 (sample sizes meet the ≥6 participants requirement: 141 bvFTD, 99 controls). Inclusion criteria not met: I3 (imaging modality is T1 structural volumetry/segmentation, not VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET), I6 (no between-group contrast reported in MNI/Talairach space for bvFTD vs controls), I7 (no whole-brain voxelwise group-level result), and I8 (no peak coordinates reported). Full text appears complete for screening (fulltext_incomplete=false). Given E6 and lack of voxelwise coordinates/whole-brain results, the study does not meet the meta-analysis inclusion requirements.

Study meets several inclusion criteria (I3: uses resting-state fMRI; I4: includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients; I5: patient and control group sizes >=6; I7: reports group-level whole-brain voxelwise analyses using ICA/dual regression and TBSS). However, the full text provided does not report any peak coordinates (x,y,z in MNI or Talairach) for bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrasts—coordinates are not present in the main text and supplementary tables are referenced but not provided here. Therefore inclusion criteria I6 and I8 (defined-space between-group peak coordinates reported) are not satisfied in the available content. No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) are met. Based on the requirement that ALL inclusion criteria must be satisfied, the study must be excluded from the meta-analysis on the basis of missing reported peak coordinates (I6 and I8 not met).

While this empirical study uses VBM (I3), includes a clinically diagnosed behavioural-variant FTD subgroup (bvFTD present; I4), and has sufficient patient numbers (bvFTD n=21; I5), it does not report any between-group whole-brain (voxelwise) contrast of bvFTD versus healthy controls that is clearly attributed to the bvFTD group (I6 not met). The manuscript’s VBM results focus on symptom-correlates within combined FTLD cohorts and C9orf72 subanalyses, and although a separate VBM comparison of disease subgroups versus controls is referenced in Supplementary material, no explicit whole-brain bvFTD-versus-control peak coordinates (MNI/Talairach) for a bvFTD-only contrast are presented in the provided full text (I7 and I8 not met). No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) apply. Therefore the study does not satisfy all required inclusion criteria for this meta-analysis.

This is an empirical longitudinal neuropsychological study of bvFTD and AD but does not use the imaging modalities required by the review. Inclusion criteria met: I4 (clinically diagnosed bvFTD participants included; bvFTD n=22) and I5 (patient sample size ≥6; bvFTD group size 22; healthy controls present). Inclusion criteria NOT met: I3 (study does not use VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET — only a subset underwent PiB-PET, which is amyloid PET and not one of the required modalities), I6 (no between-group whole-brain imaging contrasts reported in MNI/Talairach space comparing bvFTD to controls), I7 (no group-level, whole-brain voxelwise imaging results from the target sample), and I8 (no peak coordinates reported). Exclusion criteria met: none. Full text appears complete (introduction, methods, results, discussion included). Therefore the study must be excluded because it fails to satisfy the imaging- and coordinate-related inclusion criteria (I3, I6, I7, I8).

The study meets multiple inclusion criteria (I3: uses VBM; I4: includes clinically probable bvFTD patients [n=19]; I5: sample sizes satisfy minimums for bvFTD and controls; I6: reports between-group VBM contrasts vs. Controls in MNI space; I7: reports whole-brain voxelwise VBM analyses). However, the provided full text does not contain any actual peak coordinates (x,y,z) for bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrasts, which is required by I8. No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) apply. Therefore the paper must be excluded from the meta-analysis dataset as provided because inclusion criterion I8 (reporting of peak coordinates) is not satisfied in the supplied material. Note: the methods state that coordinates are provided in MNI space in the original paper/figures, but numeric peak coordinates are not present in the supplied full text content, so I8 cannot be confirmed.

The study meets many imaging and sample criteria (VBM used; clinically diagnosed bvFTD sample; n=58 patients; whole-brain voxelwise analyses reported in MNI space) but the provided full text does not report any peak coordinates (x,y,z) for bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrasts in the main manuscript. Coordinates are referenced as residing in Supplementary eTables/Figures, which are not included here, so I cannot verify inclusion criterion I8. Because I8 (reporting of peak coordinates) cannot be confirmed from the available content, the study cannot be included for this meta-analysis. Full text appears to omit the supplementary materials that likely contain the coordinates, so fulltext_incomplete is set to true.

The study meets multiple inclusion criteria (I3, I4, I5, I6, I7) but does not report any peak coordinates for a bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast in the provided full text. Specifically: (a) Exclusion criteria met: none. (b) Inclusion criteria met: I3 (task-based fMRI used), I4 (bvFTD participants included; 17 bvFTD cases), I5 (bvFTD group n=17; controls n=22), I6 (between-group contrasts versus controls reported for bvFTD), I7 (whole-brain voxelwise analyses reported). (c) Inclusion criteria not met: I8 (no MNI/Talairach peak coordinates for bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast are reported in the supplied text or tables). Because I8 is required, the paper cannot be included. Full text appears complete (introduction, methods, results, discussion present), so fulltext_incomplete=false.

This study is empirical and includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD sample (N=10) and control groups, satisfying I4 and I5. However, it does not use VBM, task- or resting-state fMRI, or FDG-PET imaging (it used structural MRI with FreeSurfer-derived ROI volumetrics), so I3 is not met. The paper does not report any whole-brain, voxelwise group-level contrasts in a standard stereotactic space nor peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space (I6, I7, and I8 are not met). The reported neuroimaging results are ROI-based volumetric comparisons and correlations, which fall under exclusion criterion E6 (results from region-of-interest analyses without unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise results). Therefore the manuscript must be excluded from the meta-analysis.

This study is excluded because its imaging data are surface-based cortical thickness (vertex-by-vertex) analyses rather than VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET (does not meet I3) and therefore falls under exclusion E9 (studies that only report cortical thickness methods). The paper does include clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients (meets I4), has adequate sample sizes (88 bvFTD, 30 controls; meets I5), and reports whole-brain vertex-wise analyses (meets I7). However, it does not report peak coordinates in MNI or Talairach space for any bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast (fails I8) and does not provide clear voxelwise results in a defined stochastic space as required (fails I6). Full text appears complete. Given the modality mismatch (E9) and missing coordinate reporting (I8/I6 not met), the study does not satisfy all inclusion criteria required for the meta-analysis.

Excluded because the study uses surface-based cortical thickness analysis (FreeSurfer) rather than VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET, so it fails inclusion criterion I3. It also reports only cortical thickness-based results (falling under exclusion E9). The study does include clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients (I4), has adequate sample sizes (I5), and reports whole-brain vertexwise discriminative maps (I7). However, it does not provide peak coordinates in MNI or Talairach space (failing I6 and I8). Full text appears complete.

The manuscript reports VBM analyses comparing clinically-diagnosed bvFTD patients (n=34) to healthy controls (n=30) with whole-brain, group-level voxelwise contrasts (DARTEL/SPM8, FDR-corrected). Thus inclusion criteria I3 (VBM), I4 (clinically-diagnosed bvFTD sample), I5 (sample sizes ≥6), I6 (between-group contrasts) and I7 (whole-brain voxelwise results) are satisfied. However, the provided full text does not include any peak coordinates (x,y,z in MNI or Talairach space) for the reported whole-brain bvFTD-versus-control contrasts; coordinates are not present in the main text, tables, figure captions, or the supplementary material supplied here (Supplementary Table 1 is referenced but its contents, including coordinates, are not provided). Because inclusion criterion I8 (reporting of peak coordinates for at least one whole-brain bvFTD-versus-control contrast) is not met in the available full text, the study must be excluded. No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) are triggered by the content provided.

The study is excluded because it does not provide a bvFTD-specific whole-brain contrast versus controls. It uses VBM (I3), includes bvFTD patients within its sample (I4), has adequate group sizes (10 patients, 20 controls; I5), and reports peak coordinates in MNI space (I8). However, the relevant between-group contrasts compare mixed FTD groups (FTD/SQSTM1 carriers or Sporadic FTD) versus controls rather than an isolated bvFTD-only group; therefore criteria I6 (contrast of bvFTD group vs controls where bvFTD is not pooled) and I7 (a group-level whole-brain voxelwise result clearly identified as from the bvFTD target group) are not met. No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) apply. Full text appears complete for screening.

Although the study uses resting-state fMRI and includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group with adequate sample sizes, it does not report peak stereotactic coordinates for any bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (resting-state fMRI used), I4 (bvFTD patients included), I5 (≥6 patients and controls), I6 (between-group contrasts bvFTD vs controls are reported). Inclusion criteria not met: I7 (no clearly reported group-level whole-brain voxelwise result with coordinates identified as from the bvFTD group) and I8 (no peak coordinates x,y,z in MNI/Talairach are provided). No exclusion criteria from the provided list were triggered. Therefore the study must be excluded because it fails the required coordinate reporting and whole-brain voxelwise result criteria (I7 and I8).

This resting-state fMRI study includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients and matched controls and uses graph-theory network centrality on AAL-derived ROIs. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (resting-state fMRI), I4 (clinically diagnosed bvFTD sample), I5 (patient and control groups ≥6). However the paper does not report any whole-brain, voxelwise between-group contrasts in stereotactic (MNI/Talairach) space nor does it provide peak coordinates. The results are presented as ROI/network-level centrality differences based on an atlas parcellation (AAL) rather than unrestricted voxelwise maps. Therefore it fails I6, I7, and I8 and meets exclusion criterion E6 (results derive from region-of-interest/atlas-parcellation analyses without whole-brain peak coordinates). Full text appears complete.

This study meets multiple inclusion criteria: it uses voxel-based morphometry (VBM) on structural MRI (I3), includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients (n=52) (I4), has sufficient sample sizes (52 patients, 52 controls) (I5), reports voxelwise between-group VBM contrasts in MNI space comparing bvFTD vs controls (I6), and provides whole-brain voxelwise group results (I7). However, the provided full text does not report any explicit peak coordinates (x,y,z) in MNI or Talairach space for any bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast; no tables or figure captions with coordinates are present in the supplied content. Because the paper as provided fails to satisfy I8 (explicit peak coordinates), it must be excluded per the protocol. No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) are triggered by the available content. Full text appears complete for core sections, so fulltext_incomplete=false.

This study is excluded because it does not meet the imaging and whole-brain voxelwise reporting requirements. (a) Exclusion criteria met: E6 — the reported imaging analysis is a region-of-interest (manual tracing of the hypothalamus) with no unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise results. (b) Inclusion criteria met: I4 (includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients) and I5 (bvFTD group N=19, controls N=23, both ≥6). (c) Inclusion criteria not met: I3 (imaging modality is manual hypothalamic volumetry, not VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET), I6 (no between-group voxelwise contrast reported in MNI/Talairach space comparing bvFTD vs controls), I7 (no whole-brain voxelwise group-level results), and I8 (no peak coordinates reported). Full text appears complete (introduction, methods, results, discussion present). Therefore the paper must be excluded from the meta-analysis focused on voxelwise whole-brain imaging studies reporting stereotactic coordinates.

While this study uses VBM (I3), includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD sample (n=24) and healthy controls (n=24) meeting minimum sizes (I4, I5), and it reports group-level whole-brain voxelwise VBM results within the bvFTD sample (I7), it does not report a between-group voxelwise contrast of bvFTD versus controls in a standard stereotactic space (MNI/Talairach) with reported peak coordinates. The VBM results described are within-group neuroanatomical associations (regressions of grey matter on language performance) rather than a bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast, and no peak (x,y,z) coordinates for a bvFTD>control or bvFTD<control whole-brain contrast are provided. Therefore inclusion criteria I6 and I8 are not met. No exclusion criteria from the review were triggered. Full text appears complete.

This study meets all inclusion criteria: (I4) includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD sample (n=32) and matched healthy controls (n=17); (I5) sample sizes exceed the minimum (≥6 per group); (I3) uses voxel-wise gray matter density analysis from structural T1 MRI consistent with VBM-style analysis; (I6/I7) reports whole-brain, group-level voxelwise comparisons of bvFTD vs controls (Randomise in FSL with family-wise error correction) and regression analyses relating f0 range to GM density; (I8) the manuscript indicates peak atrophy and regression results are summarized in table e-1 (supplement), implying reported peak coordinates for the voxelwise contrasts. No exclusion criteria apply (no ROI-only results, not a review, not another imaging modality only, and bvFTD cases are separable). Full text contains Introduction, Methods, Results, and Discussion; supplemental table referenced for coordinates is acceptable. Therefore include for the meta-analysis.

Exclusion decision because the paper does not report any whole-brain, voxelwise between-group contrasts comparing a bvFTD group to controls nor does it provide peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (uses FDG-PET as an imaging modality), I4 (includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD participants), I5 (bvFTD subgroup size ≥6: reported 6 probable + 1 definitive bvFTD ≈7). Inclusion criteria not met: I6 (no reported between-group contrasts bvFTD vs controls in defined space), I7 (no group-level whole-brain voxelwise results identified as from the bvFTD sample), I8 (no peak coordinates reported). No exclusion criteria from the provided list apply. Full text appears complete (introduction, methods, results, discussion). Therefore the study must be excluded for failing essential imaging/results criteria required for coordinate-based meta-analysis.

The study uses VBM (yes), includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD subgroup (16 bvFTD patients) and has adequate group sizes (bvFTD n=16; controls n=20). However, the imaging results reported are correlational analyses within the FTD patient sample (VBM correlation between SAM/autonomic ratios and grey-matter atrophy, reporting coordinates for left putamen) rather than a whole-brain between-group voxelwise contrast directly comparing a bvFTD group to healthy controls. The manuscript does not present a bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain voxelwise contrast with peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space. Therefore it fails inclusion criteria I6, I7, and I8 and cannot be included in the meta-analysis focused on bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrasts.

This study uses voxel-based morphometry (VBM) (Methods: FSL VBM) and reports whole-brain, group-level VBM comparisons between bvFTD and healthy controls (Results: ‘Compared with controls, bvFTD showed grey matter intensity decreases…’; group-wise comparisons reference Supplementary Table 1 and Supplementary Fig. 1). The sample includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group (n=25) and healthy controls (n=24), meeting the minimum group size requirement. The paper reports voxelwise results and provides peak coordinates for several VBM-related analyses in MNI space (EMG and SCL correlates are reported with MNI coordinates in the text; groupwise VBM contrasts are referenced with Supplementary Table 1 where group-contrast peaks are typically tabulated). Therefore all required inclusion criteria (I3, I4, I5, I6, I7, I8) are satisfied. No exclusion criteria are met. Confidence is moderate-high because peak coordinates for the bvFTD vs. control groupwise VBM contrast are referenced to Supplementary Table 1 (not reproduced in the provided main-text excerpt), but the main-text explicitly describes whole-brain VBM group contrasts and references the supplementary table that contains the detailed results.

This is an empirical VBM study of bvFTD: (1) used FSL-VBM (voxel-based morphometry) (I3); (2) included clinically diagnosed bvFTD participants (28 bvFTD) (I4); (3) sample sizes meet thresholds (28 bvFTD, 19 controls) (I5); (4) pairwise voxelwise group analyses were performed comparing bvFTD and controls (I6,I7); (5) the manuscript states that maximum voxel coordinates were provided in stereotaxic space (MNI/Talairach) (I8). Whole-brain, group-level, voxelwise results are reported and not confined to ROI analyses. No exclusion criteria apply. Full text contains introduction, methods, results, and discussion and appears complete for screening (fulltext_incomplete=false).

This is a single-case clinical case report of one patient with bvFTD using clinical MRI and FDG-PET. While it addresses bvFTD and used FDG-PET (I3) and includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD patient (I4), it does not meet critical meta-analysis inclusion requirements: the patient group size is <6 (I5 not met), there are no between-group bvFTD-versus-control contrasts reported in MNI/Talairach space (I6 not met), no group-level whole-brain voxelwise results are reported (I7 not met), and no peak coordinates are provided (I8 not met). No exclusion criteria are triggered. Full text appears complete. Therefore exclude.

This study uses VBM and includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD subgroup (n=22) and an adequate healthy control cohort (n=50), but it does not report any between-group, whole-brain voxelwise contrast of bvFTD versus healthy controls with peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space. The VBM analyses reported relate to correlations of auditory-hedonic symptoms within the combined FTLD cohort or AD cohort and symptom-based contrasts (some results reported after small-volume correction); there are no bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrasts or peak coordinates. This study is excluded because it does not meet key inclusion criteria for the meta-analysis: it uses structural MRI volumetry (SIENA/SIENAX) rather than VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET (I3 not met); the bvFTD sample size is only 1 patient (I5 not met); there are no reported whole-brain voxelwise between-group contrasts or peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space (I6, I7, I8 not met). This study meets all required inclusion criteria for the meta-analysis: it uses voxel-based morphometry (VBM) (I3), includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients (n=35) (I4), and has adequate sample sizes (bvFTD n=35; controls n=29; VBM subsample bvFTD n=12, controls n=20) exceeding the minimum of 6 (I5). This study uses VBM and includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group (n=64) and healthy controls (n=32), and reports whole-brain voxelwise analyses within bvFTD. This is an empirical VBM study that includes a clearly diagnosed bvFTD group (n=69) and healthy controls (n=28). Full text appears complete (introduction, methods, results, discussion).

This is an original, empirical multimodal MRI study that includes VBM analyses (I3) and a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group (n=20) compared with healthy controls (n=20) (I4, I5). The study meets multiple inclusion criteria: it uses VBM and resting-state (task-free) fMRI (I3), includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD participants (I4), has adequate sample sizes (28 patients; controls n=14/42) (I5), reports between-group contrasts versus controls in MNI space (I6), and provides whole-brain voxelwise group-level results (I7). This empirical study used whole-brain VBM (structural MRI) and FDG-PET (I3) and included clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients per published criteria (I4). Patient group sizes exceed thresholds (23 bvFTD; MRI/PET after QC: 21/23) and controls are sufficient (I5). The paper reports direct between-group voxelwise contrasts of bvFTD versus healthy controls in MNI space with conversion to Talairach and refers to peak maxima coordinates in Tables 2 and 3 (I6, I7, I8). Analyses are whole-brain voxelwise (not ROI-only) and there is no indication of exclusion criteria being met (e.g., review, non-empirical, ROI-only, or predominantly other diagnoses). The full article text includes introduction, methods, results, and discussion; referenced tables contain stereotactic peaks. Therefore the study meets all inclusion criteria and no exclusion criteria apply.

Excluded because the reported voxelwise morphometry results were restricted to a merged subcortical grey-matter mask (i.e., an ROI-based voxelwise analysis), and the manuscript does not provide an unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise bvFTD-versus-control contrast with peak coordinates. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (VBM-type voxelwise morphometry was performed), I4 (a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group is included, n=10), I5 (bvFTD group and controls meet sample size requirements), I6 (between-group contrasts of phenotype groups vs controls are reported). Inclusion criteria not met: I7 (no whole-brain, unrestricted voxelwise result for the bvFTD group is reported), I8 (no peak coordinates for a whole-brain bvFTD>control contrast are provided in the supplied full text). Exclusion criteria applied: E6 (qualifying results come from an analysis confined to an anatomical mask; no unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise result is available). Full text appears complete.

This is an empirical VBM study that includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group (n=18) and healthy controls (n=27). The authors report whole-brain, voxelwise bvFTD-versus-control contrasts (age included as nuisance) with results corrected for multiple comparisons and provide peak coordinates in MNI space (e.g., bvFTD: x=8, y=28, z=-28). The paper therefore meets imaging modality (VBM), sample, sample size, between-group contrast, whole-brain evidence, and coordinate-reporting criteria. No exclusion criteria are met (not a review, not ROI-only, not other modalities only, and bvFTD cases are separable). Full text appears complete (includes Introduction, Methods, Results, Discussion).

(a) Exclusion IDs met: none. (b) Inclusion IDs met: I3 (FDG-PET was used), I4 (study included clinically diagnosed behavioral variant FTD patients), I5 (patient group has ≥6 bvFTD cases—20 FTD patients total; control group ≥6). (c) Inclusion IDs not met: I6 (no reported between-group whole-brain voxelwise contrast comparing bvFTD group to controls in MNI/Talairach space), I7 (no group-level whole-brain voxelwise results identified for the bvFTD group), I8 (no peak coordinates reported for any bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast). The full text is complete. Because key meta-analysis requirements (voxelwise group contrasts and reported coordinates) are absent, this study does not provide the required spatial coordinate data and must be excluded.

This study is excluded because it does not meet key inclusion criteria for the meta-analysis. Inclusion criteria met: I4 (includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients), I5 (bvFTD group n=11 ≥6), I7 (reports whole-brain voxelwise analyses identified as coming from the bvFTD sample). Inclusion criteria NOT met: I3 (imaging modality is tensor-based morphometry (TBM) derived from T1 MRI, not VBM, task/resting-state fMRI, or FDG-PET), I6 (between-group contrasts are bvFTD vs early-onset AD rather than bvFTD vs healthy controls as required), and I8 (no peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space are reported for any whole-brain bvFTD-versus-control contrast). No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) apply. Full text appears complete (methods, results, discussion present). Given failure to satisfy modality and coordinate requirements, the paper must be excluded from the coordinate-based meta-analysis.

The study is excluded because it does not meet required imaging-modality and coordinate-reporting inclusion criteria. Inclusion criteria met: I4 (contains clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients), I5 (bvFTD n=9 and controls n=18), I6 (reports between-group voxelwise contrasts using TBSS/Randomise in standard space), and I7 (reports group-level whole-brain voxelwise WM results for the bvFTD group). Inclusion criteria NOT met: I3 (does NOT use VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET — modalities are DTI, structural ROI volumetry, and ASL perfusion), and I8 (no peak MNI/Talairach coordinates are reported for bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrasts). No exclusion criteria from the protocol are triggered (e.g., the paper is empirical and not a review, and results are not ROI-only since TBSS voxelwise results are reported). Because two required inclusion items (I3 and I8) are unmet, the study must be excluded.

The full text is complete. This study is excluded because, although it includes bvFTD patients and uses FDG-PET (I3, I4) and has sufficient patient numbers (n=27) (I5), it does not report any whole-brain, voxelwise between-group contrasts of bvFTD versus healthy controls in a defined stereotactic space, nor does it provide peak coordinates. Specifically, the imaging analyses were visual ratings of MRI and FDG-PET and consensus clinical interpretation rather than VBM/fMRI/voxelwise FDG-PET statistic maps with MNI/Talairach peak coordinates. Therefore inclusion criteria I6, I7, and I8 are not met. No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) apply. Inclusion criteria met: I3, I4, I5. Inclusion criteria not met: I6, I7, I8. The study reports a VBM analysis comparing clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients (n=26) to healthy controls (n=23) and provides whole-brain voxelwise results described as clusters in MNI space. However, the provided full text does not include any explicit peak coordinates (x,y,z) for the bvFTD-versus-control voxelwise contrasts; coordinates may exist in supplementary material or tables not included here. Therefore inclusion criterion I8 (peak coordinates reported) is not satisfied. No exclusion criteria are met based on the provided content.

While this study uses voxel-based morphometry (VBM) and includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD sample (24 bvFTD patients) with sufficient group size, it does NOT report any between-group whole-brain contrasts comparing the bvFTD group to healthy controls. The VBM results are presented as voxelwise correlations of insight-discrepancy scores across a mixed patient cohort and domain-wise covariation analyses; the authors state that separate analyses within individual patient groups produced no significant results. Therefore the study satisfies I3 (VBM used), I4 (bvFTD patients included), and I5 (bvFTD group n>=6), but fails I6 (no bvFTD vs control whole-brain contrast), I7 (no group-level whole-brain result identified as coming from the bvFTD target group), and I8 (no peak coordinates reported for a bvFTD-versus-control contrast). No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) are triggered. Full text appears complete.

This study used FDG-PET (I3) and included clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients after follow-up (I4) with at least 15 bvFTD cases (I5). However, it does not report any group-level whole-brain (voxelwise) bvFTD-versus-control contrasts, nor does it present peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space. Results are qualitative (visual reads) and diagnostic accuracy metrics, not voxelwise statistical maps or coordinate tables. Therefore inclusion criteria I6, I7, and I8 are not met, and the study cannot contribute coordinates for coordinate-based meta-analysis. Full text appears complete. Exclusion criterion applied: E6 (no unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise result reported / qualifying result not a whole-brain voxelwise contrast).

This study is excluded because it uses cortical thickness (surface-based FreeSurfer) and subcortical volume analyses rather than the imaging modalities required by the review (VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET), and the review's exclusion criterion E9 (cortical thickness methods) therefore applies. Inclusion criteria met: I4 (includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients), I5 (bvFTD group n=37 and controls n=33, both ≥6), and I7 (reports whole-brain vertex-wise surface analyses identified for the bvFTD group). Inclusion criteria not met: I3 (imaging modality is cortical thickness/FreeSurfer, not VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET), I6 and I8 (no peak MNI/Talairach coordinates for whole-brain bvFTD-versus-control contrasts are provided in the supplied full text; coordinates appear not to be reported in the main text). Full text appears complete (introduction, methods, results, discussion present). Therefore excluded based on E9.

This empirical study reports whole-brain voxel-based morphometry (VBM) analyses including bvFTD patients versus healthy controls, with MNI stereotaxic coordinates provided for results. The sample includes 12 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients and 12 controls (both ≥6). The paper presents group-level, whole-brain voxelwise contrasts (bvFTD vs. Controls) and explicitly states that maximum coordinates are provided in MNI space. Imaging modality (VBM), patient sample, sample sizes, whole-brain voxelwise results, and reported coordinates satisfy the meta-analysis inclusion criteria. No exclusion criteria are met. Full text appears complete (introduction, methods, results, discussion, and supplemental references).

The study meets multiple inclusion criteria (uses VBM; includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients; sample sizes: 15 bvFTD, 19 controls; reports whole-brain group comparisons and voxelwise analyses in MNI space). However the full text as provided does not report peak coordinates (x,y,z in MNI or Talairach space) for any bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast; reported numeric coordinates are for a brain–behavior regression (intentionality vs GM) rather than the between-group atrophy contrast. Inclusion criterion I8 (explicit peak coordinates for at least one whole-brain bvFTD-versus-control contrast) is therefore not satisfied, which prevents inclusion. Full text appears complete. No exclusion criteria are met.

Although this study uses FDG-PET (I3), enrolls a clinically diagnosed probable bvFTD sample (n=17) meeting the minimum sample size (I4, I5), and reports group-level whole-brain voxelwise SPM results (I7), it does not report an explicit between-group bvFTD-versus-controls contrast in MNI/Talairach space (I6 not met). The analyses are based on single-subject contrasts versus a normative database and one-sample group tests derived from those contrasts rather than a direct between-group contrast against a contemporaneous control group. Crucially, no peak coordinates (x,y,z) for any whole-brain bvFTD-versus-control contrast are provided in the text, tables, or figure captions (I8 not met). Therefore the study fails the coordinate-reporting requirement and cannot be included.

This study meets several inclusion criteria: I3 (FDG‑PET was used), I4 (includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group), I5 (bvFTD N=24 and controls N=32), I6 (between‑group contrasts bvFTD vs controls in SPM normalized to MNI space), and I7 (reports whole‑brain voxelwise group analyses). However I8 is not met in the provided full text: no peak coordinates (x,y,z in MNI or Talairach space) for any bvFTD-versus-control whole‑brain contrast are reported in the text supplied (only anatomical cluster descriptions). I found no tables or figure captions containing coordinates in the provided content; coordinates may exist in supplementary materials online, but they are not present here for verification. Therefore the paper cannot be included under the meta-analysis rules requiring reported peak coordinates.

This VBM study includes a clearly defined bvFTD patient sample (n=22) and age-matched controls (n=17), uses voxel-based morphometry as the imaging modality, and reports voxel-wise group-level contrasts and covariate analyses with results described in MNI space (the methods state that maximum coordinates are reported in MNI coordinates). The patient and control groups each exceed the minimum sample size (>=6). The paper reports group-level voxelwise atrophy contrasts comparing bvFTD to controls and provides peak coordinates for significant clusters (reported in the methods and results), satisfying whole-brain voxelwise reporting requirements. No exclusion criteria apply (not a review, not restricted to ROI-only results without whole-brain contrasts, not other imaging modality-only, and bvFTD cases are a separable target group). Full text appears complete (introduction, methods, results, discussion present).

This study is excluded because it does not use the required imaging modalities (I3 not met): it uses structural longitudinal MRI with tensor-based morphometry and boundary-shift integral rather than VBM, fMRI, or FDG‑PET. It also does not report any bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain voxelwise contrasts with peak coordinates and does not include a healthy control group for such contrasts (I6, I7, I8 not met). Inclusion criteria met: I4 (clinically diagnosed bvFTD participants are included) and I5 (patient group sizes exceed 6). No exclusion criteria are triggered. Full text appears complete and contains methods, results, and discussion supporting these determinations.

This is an empirical FDG-PET study of clinically diagnosed bv‐FTD patients (final sample n=8) versus healthy controls (n=26). The paper reports whole-brain, voxelwise SPM group contrasts comparing bv‐FTD to controls with FWE-corrected results and refers to peak coordinates (reported in Table III) for significant clusters (bv‐FTD < controls). Imaging modality (FDG‐PET), target sample (bv‐FTD), adequate sample sizes (≥6 per group), presence of between-group voxelwise contrasts in a defined statistical space, whole-brain group-level results, and reported peak coordinates satisfy the review inclusion criteria. Full text includes Introduction, Methods, Results, and Discussion, so is complete for screening. No exclusion criteria (e.g., review, ROI-only analysis, wrong modality, or mixed-diagnosis pooling) are met.

Full text reports VBM analyses comparing bvFTD (n=16) to controls (n=17) and provides whole-brain voxelwise atrophy results; thus I3, I4, I5, I6, and I7 are satisfied. However, the provided full text does not include any peak coordinates (x,y,z) for the bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrasts — those coordinates appear to be referenced as being in Supplementary Tables/Figures which are not present here. Because I cannot confirm the presence of peak coordinates (I8), the record fails to meet all required inclusion criteria. No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) apply based on the available text. As supplementary material likely contains the coordinates but is missing from the provided full text, I mark fulltext_incomplete=true and exclude pending access to the complete article (including supplements) that contains the reported coordinates.

This study uses FDG-PET (I3 met), includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group (n=11) (I4 met), and has >=6 participants in patient and control groups (I5 met). However, it does NOT report any whole-brain, between-group voxelwise contrast directly comparing bvFTD versus healthy controls with peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space. The PET analyses reported are voxelwise regression correlations across all subjects with deficit scores and group-difference comments are reported from extracted regional values (non-voxelwise). Therefore inclusion criteria I6, I7 and I8 are not satisfied. No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) are triggered. Full text appears complete. Exclusion reason: fails to provide a bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain voxelwise contrast with reported peak coordinates (I6, I7, I8 not met).

This study is excluded because it does not provide whole-brain voxelwise results or peak coordinates required for coordinate-based meta-analysis. (a) Exclusion criteria met: E6 (results are ROI/tract-based and no unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise contrasts are reported) and E9 (primary imaging results are DTI tractography and ROI-based resting-state fMRI connectivity rather than VBM, whole-brain fMRI voxelwise maps, or FDG-PET). (b) Inclusion criteria met: I3 (uses resting-state fMRI as an imaging modality), I4 (includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients), I5 (bvFTD and control groups each >=6 participants). (c) Inclusion criteria not met: I6 (no reported between-group voxelwise contrast in MNI/Talairach space), I7 (no whole-brain voxelwise group-level result), I8 (no peak coordinates reported). This study is excluded because its VBM results were derived from an a priori PFC/MTL region-of-interest mask rather than an unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise analysis, meeting exclusion criterion E6. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (VBM imaging), I4 (clinically diagnosed bvFTD sample present), I5 (bvFTD n=22 and controls n=38, both ≥6), I6 (between-group bvFTD vs control contrasts reported), and I8 (peak coordinates reported in MNI space). Inclusion criterion not met: I7 (requires at least one group-level whole-brain voxelwise result from the target sample; the paper reports only ROI-masked voxelwise results). Full text appears complete.

The study is excluded because it does not report whole-brain, voxelwise between-group contrasts in a standard stereotactic space nor report peak coordinates. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (uses [18F]FDG-PET), I4 (includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD cases), I5 (bvFTD patient group n=27 ≥6). Inclusion criteria not met: I6 (no reported between-group contrast in MNI/Talairach space comparing bvFTD to controls), I7 (no group-level whole-brain voxelwise result), I8 (no peak coordinates reported). The imaging analyses were visual/readings and diagnostic accuracy metrics (sensitivity/specificity), not voxelwise or coordinate-based results. Full text appears complete and sufficient to make this determination.

This study is excluded because it does not report any between-group bvFTD-versus-control contrast with reported peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (uses FDG-PET), I4 (clinically diagnosed bvFTD sample), I5 (≥6 bvFTD patients; n=37), I7 (reports whole-brain voxelwise group-level analyses within the bvFTD sample relating occupation to FDG metabolism). Inclusion criteria not met: I6 (no explicit between-group bvFTD vs. control contrast in stereotactic space is reported), I8 (no peak coordinates for any whole-brain bvFTD-versus-control contrast are provided in the text). No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) apply. Full text appears complete for screening purposes.

Although this study uses VBM (I3) in a clinically-diagnosed bvFTD sample (I4) with n=20 patients (I5), it does NOT report any between-group bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain voxelwise contrasts in MNI/Talairach space. The reported results are within-group correlations between gray-matter volume and SEA subscores in the bvFTD group (some reported as peak coordinates), and the imaging analyses were performed inside an a priori frontal mask (region-restricted analysis). Therefore the study fails to meet I6 (no bvFTD vs. control contrast), I7 (no whole‑brain group-level voxelwise result vs controls), and I8 (no peak coordinates for a bvFTD-versus-control contrast). Because the qualifying results are confined to an anatomical mask (ROI-restricted VBM), exclusion criterion E6 applies. Full text appears complete.

While this is an empirical MRI study of clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients (n=28) with healthy controls (n=26), it does not use VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET. The study uses manual ROI-based segmentation and surface/shape analysis (SPHARM-PDM) of the caudate and putamen rather than whole-brain voxelwise analyses. No whole-brain, voxelwise bvFTD-versus-control contrasts in a standard stereotaxic space (MNI/Talairach) are reported, and no peak coordinates are provided. Therefore it fails inclusion criteria I3, I6, I7, and I8. Additionally, the qualifying results are ROI-based (striatal volume/shape), meeting exclusion criterion E6 (region-of-interest analysis without unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise results). Inclusion criteria met: I4 (clinically diagnosed bvFTD sample) and I5 (sample sizes ≥6). Given these mismatches with the meta-analysis imaging and reporting requirements, the study should be excluded.

Excluded because the study reports only diffusion tensor imaging (DTI/TBSS) and seed-based resting-state fMRI connectivity analyses rather than VBM, task fMRI, or FDG-PET whole-brain voxelwise contrasts required for inclusion; this meets exclusion criterion E9. The study does meet multiple inclusion criteria: I3 (uses resting-state fMRI), I4 (includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients), I5 (sample sizes: 12 bvFTD, 17 controls), I6 (reports between-group contrasts of bvFTD vs controls), and I7 (performs whole-brain voxelwise analyses). However it does not satisfy I8 because no peak coordinates (MNI/Talairach x,y,z) for bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrasts are presented in the provided full text (they are only referenced as Supplementary Tables/Figures without coordinates in the main text). Therefore the paper must be excluded.

This study should be excluded because it does not meet the imaging-modality and whole-brain coordinate reporting requirements of the review. Inclusion criteria met: I4 (sample includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients) and I5 (patient and control groups each have ≥6 participants). Inclusion criteria not met: I3 (imaging modality is structural MRI volumetry using Freesurfer, not VBM, task/resting fMRI, or FDG‑PET), I6 (no between-group contrast reported in a standard stereotactic space like MNI/Talairach), I7 (no whole‑brain voxelwise group-level result reported; analyses are ROI/volume-based), and I8 (no peak coordinates reported for any bvFTD‑vs‑control whole‑brain contrast). Exclusion criteria met: E6 (results derive from region-of-interest/ROI volumetric analyses rather than unrestricted whole‑brain voxelwise analyses). This study reports whole-brain voxel-based morphometry (VBM) analyses comparing a clinically diagnosed behavioural-variant FTD (bvFTD) patient group to healthy controls. The bvFTD group (n=10) and control group (n=14) each exceed the minimum sample-size threshold. VBM (an accepted imaging modality per I3) was used and voxel-wise group contrasts versus controls are presented. Results are reported in MNI space with peak coordinates provided in the tables (e.g., Table 4 and Table 5), and whole-brain, voxelwise covariate analyses are described. The bvFTD group is analyzed separately (not pooled) for bvFTD-versus-control contrasts. The full text contains methods, results, and discussion, and is complete for screening. No exclusion criteria (e.g., ROI-only analysis, non-empirical paper, inappropriate sample, or disallowed imaging modality) are met.

The study meets inclusion criteria I3 (uses VBM/anatomical MRI and resting-state fMRI), I4 (includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group, n=23), and I5 (bvFTD n≥6 and control n≥6). However it does NOT meet I6–I8: the provided full text, while reporting voxel-wise processing and regional findings, does not report any whole-brain peak coordinates (x,y,z in MNI or Talairach) for bvFTD-versus-control contrasts, nor explicit whole-brain voxelwise result tables or coordinate lists. Inclusion criterion I8 (required peak coordinates) is therefore not satisfied; consequently I6 and I7 (reporting between-group contrasts in defined space and a clearly-identified whole-brain group-level voxelwise result) are also not met. No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) apply. Full text appears complete (fulltext_incomplete=false). Because failure to provide peak coordinates (I8) is mandatory, the paper must be excluded from the coordinate-based meta-analysis.

This full text meets the review objective and required inclusion criteria. Imaging modality: whole-brain VBM on structural MRI (I3). Sample includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients (N=50) within the FTD-spectrum (I4) and age-matched controls are reported; group sizes exceed the 6-participant minimum (I5). The paper reports whole-brain, voxelwise group-level analyses identified as coming from the target sample (FTD and syndrome-specific bvFTD) (I7). Syndrome-specific (bvFTD) whole-brain contrasts and resulting peak coordinates in MNI space are provided (reported in text/Tables/Figures; Table 4 and figure captions), satisfying the requirement for at least one between-group contrast with coordinates (I6, I8). No exclusion criteria apply (not a review, not ROI-only, uses VBM, bvFTD separable, empirical data present). Full text appears complete (introduction, methods, results, discussion).

This full-text reports whole-brain voxel-based morphometry (VBM) analyses comparing a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group (n=24) to cognitively normal controls (n=179). Imaging modality is VBM on structural MRI. The paper reports group-level, whole-brain voxelwise contrasts (bvFTD vs controls and interaction effects) and provides peak coordinates in MNI space for multiple significant clusters (e.g., MNI = 12,18,9; 30,-7,-15; -46,36,15). Both patient and control groups exceed the minimum size of 6. The bvFTD group is analyzed separately (not pooled). The full article text (introduction, methods, results, discussion) is present. No exclusion criteria (reviews, ROI-only results, non-empirical, wrong modality, or mixed-diagnosis predominance) are met. Therefore the study satisfies all required inclusion criteria.

Exclude per E7: the study’s patient groups are primary progressive aphasia (PPA) variants and Alzheimer’s disease, not behavioral-variant FTD (bvFTD) or Pick’s disease. Inclusion criteria met: I5 (sample size requirement: patient group n=6 PPA; control group n=8). Inclusion criteria not met: I3 (modality is dual-phase 18F-florbetapir PET, not VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET), I4 (does not include clinically diagnosed bvFTD/Pick’s disease), I6 (no between-group contrast comparing a bvFTD group to controls), I7 (no whole-brain group-level voxelwise result identified as coming from a bvFTD target group), I8 (no peak coordinates reported for a bvFTD-versus-control contrast). Full text appears complete (fulltext_incomplete=false).

This study meets I3 (uses FDG-PET), I4 (includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients within the sample: 7 bvFTD plus related variants), and I5 (>=6 patients and >=6 controls after data exclusion). However, it does not report any group-level, whole-brain (unrestricted voxelwise) bvFTD-versus-control contrast with peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space. Group analyses are ROI-based and the voxelwise analyses described are single-subject (patient vs controls) maps; no peak coordinates or a whole-brain group-level SPM contrast are provided. Therefore it fails I6, I7, and I8 and falls under exclusion E6 (qualifying results come from ROI or non-whole-brain analyses). Full text appears complete. Exclusion IDs met: E6. Inclusion IDs met: I3, I4, I5. Inclusion IDs not met: I6, I7, I8.

Study meets imaging and sample size criteria (uses VBM; includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients, N=18; healthy controls N=34) but does NOT report a whole-brain, voxelwise bvFTD-versus-control between-group contrast with peak coordinates. The paper reports VBM contrasts between AD and bvFTD and merged-group regressions, but I find no bvFTD vs healthy control voxelwise group-level results nor any MNI/Talairach peak coordinates for such a contrast. Therefore inclusion criteria I6, I7 and I8 are not satisfied, while I3, I4 and I5 are satisfied. Full text appears complete. Exclusion applied: none of the exclusion criteria (E5–E9) were triggered.

This paper meets all required inclusion criteria for the meta-analysis: it used voxel-based morphometry (VBM) as the imaging modality; included a clinically-diagnosed bvFTD patient group (n=24) and healthy controls (n=22), both above the minimum N=6; reports whole-brain, voxelwise group-level contrasts comparing bvFTD to controls; and provides peak coordinates in MNI space (the text states maximum coordinates were provided, and specific MNI coordinates are reported, e.g., overlap at x=-38,y=30,z=-10). No exclusion criteria apply (not a review, not ROI-only, sample is bvFTD, not a non-empirical methods paper, and not restricted to excluded modalities). Full text appears complete (includes introduction, methods, results, discussion).

Study meets several inclusion criteria: it uses VBM and resting-state/task fMRI (I3), includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients (n=14) and controls (n=19) meeting sample-size requirements (I4, I5), reports between-group VBM contrasts and whole-brain voxelwise analyses comparing bvFTD to controls (I6, I7). However, the provided full text does not report peak coordinates (x,y,z) for any whole-brain bvFTD-versus-control contrast in MNI/Talairach space; the coordinates given ([−45,13,−37] and [−52,2,14]) correspond to within-patient regression analyses (AP vs. gray matter) rather than a bvFTD vs. control whole-brain contrast. Because inclusion criterion I8 (explicit peak coordinates for a bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast) is not satisfied in the provided full text, the study must be excluded. No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) are otherwise met. Full text appears complete (fulltext_incomplete=false).

This full text meets all inclusion criteria: I3 - Voxel-based morphometry (VBM) was used for grey-matter analyses; I4 - includes a clinician-diagnosed bvFTD group (n=18); I5 - sample sizes meet thresholds (bvFTD n=18, healthy controls n=18); I6 - reports between-group voxelwise contrasts comparing controls > bvFTD (bvFTD not pooled with other patient groups); I7 - whole-brain, group-level voxelwise VBM results are reported (FWE-corrected clusters, full-brain contrasts); I8 - the manuscript reports anatomical results in main-text tables and supplementary tables and uses MNI space (Table 2 and Supplementary Table 1 are cited, with MNI noted), indicating peak coordinates are provided for voxelwise contrasts/correlations. No exclusion criteria are met (exclusion_criteria_applied: []). Full text appears complete (introduction, methods, results, discussion present). Therefore the study is eligible for inclusion in the bvFTD imaging meta-analysis.

The study meets several inclusion criteria (I3: uses VBM; I4: includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group (n=11); I5: sample sizes meet minimums for patient and control groups; I6: reports between-group voxelwise contrasts in MNI space). However, the VBM analyses were conducted within a prefrontal/striatal ROI mask (i.e., region-constrained voxelwise results) rather than an unrestricted whole-brain analysis, so this qualifies as a region-of-interest–restricted result and therefore triggers exclusion criterion E6. Consequently the paper does not satisfy I7 (whole-brain, voxelwise group-level result) and does not provide peak coordinates for an unrestricted whole-brain bvFTD-versus-control contrast as required by I8. Full text appears complete. Exclusion summary: E6 applied; Inclusions met: I3, I4, I5, I6; Inclusions not met: I7, I8.

The study is excluded because it does not report any whole-brain, group-level bvFTD-versus-control voxelwise contrasts with peak coordinates. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (uses VBM), I4 (includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients), I5 (sufficient sample sizes for patient and control groups). Inclusion criteria NOT met: I6 (no reported bvFTD vs control contrast in MNI/Talairach space — reported results are genotype (COMT Val dose) effects across pooled groups), I7 (no whole-brain result clearly identified as coming from the bvFTD group specifically), I8 (no peak coordinates provided for a bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast). No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) apply. Full text appears complete and contains methods, results, and discussion, but lacks the required bvFTD-specific whole-brain contrasts and coordinates.

Excluded because the study does not use an eligible imaging modality or whole-brain voxelwise analysis. It reports Freesurfer-based regional volumetry/ROI correlations and regression analyses (not VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET), so I3 is not met. The paper does not report any group-level whole-brain (voxelwise) contrasts or peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space, so I6, I7, and I8 are not met. This paper is a study protocol/description of the ongoing LOF cohort and does not report empirical voxelwise neuroimaging results or peak coordinates. It mentions use of [18F]FDG-PET (and MRI and CSF) in planned assessments, but no between-group bvFTD-versus-control contrasts, no whole-brain group-level voxelwise results, and no MNI/Talairach peak coordinates are reported. Therefore it does not provide the required imaging results for inclusion.

The study meets several inclusion criteria: it uses VBM and FDG-PET (I3); the patient sample is clinically diagnosed FTD where semantic dementia and progressive nonfluent aphasia were explicitly excluded (consistent with bvFTD/binary FTD group) (I4); sample sizes meet the threshold (13 FTD patients, 20 controls) (I5); the analyses are whole-brain, voxelwise SPM comparisons normalized to MNI space, reporting group-level voxelwise contrasts (I6, I7). However, the full text provided does not contain any reported peak coordinates (x,y,z in MNI or Talairach) for any bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast, nor are such coordinates found in the excerpts or referenced tables/figures in the supplied content. Because inclusion criterion I8 (reported peak coordinates) is not satisfied, the study must be excluded. Exclusion IDs met: none. Inclusion IDs met: I3, I4, I5, I6, I7. Inclusion IDs not met: I8 (no reported peak coordinates).

Although this study uses VBM and includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD sample with adequate sample sizes and reports bvFTD-versus-control contrasts, the VBM analyses were performed with an a priori frontal/temporal mask (i.e., not an unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise analysis). This constitutes a region-of-interest–restricted voxelwise analysis and falls under exclusion criterion E6. In addition, the provided full-text does not contain explicit peak coordinates (x,y,z) for bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrasts, so inclusion criterion I8 is not met. Therefore the study must be excluded. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (VBM), I4 (bvFTD sample), I5 (sample sizes ≥6), I6 (between-group contrasts reported). Inclusion criteria not met: I7 (whole-brain voxelwise result from target sample), I8 (reported peak coordinates). Exclusion criteria applied: E6 (results confined to an anatomical mask/ROI). Full text appears complete for core sections, so fulltext_incomplete=false.

(a) Exclusion criteria met: E6 (results derive from ROI-based/parcellation analyses without reporting unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise results). This is an empirical imaging study that meets all inclusion criteria: it uses FDG-PET and voxel-based morphometry (I3); includes clinically diagnosed behavioural-variant FTD patients (n=24) (I4); has ≥6 patients and ≥6 controls (patients n=24, controls n=12) (I5); reports whole-brain, group-level voxelwise VBM analyses (SPM) (I7) and explicitly references peak coordinates (MNI coordinate reported in text and ‘see supplementary information for exact coordinates’) (I6,I8). The VBM contrast is derived from bvFTD subgroups and the paper indicates similar VBM findings versus controls. No exclusion criteria are met (not a review, not ROI-only, not non-empirical, and patient group is bvFTD). Full text appears complete; supplementary tables are referenced but absence of supplement is acceptable. Therefore include for the meta-analysis.

This study should be excluded because, although it uses VBM (I3), includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group (n=20) (I4), and has adequate sample sizes for patient and control groups (I5), it does NOT report any bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain voxelwise group contrasts in MNI/Talairach space nor does it provide peak coordinates. Although the study clearly uses VBM (I3), includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group (n=19) and controls (n=19) meeting the sample-size requirement (I4, I5), and reports whole-brain, group-level VBM contrasts comparing bvFTD versus controls in MNI space (I6, I7), the provided full-text does not include any peak coordinate values (x,y,z) for the bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrasts. Peak coordinates are referenced in tables/figures but those tables (where MNI coordinates would appear) are not present in the supplied content, so I8 (reporting of coordinates) cannot be verified. Full text appears incomplete for coordinate verification.

This study is excluded because it reports cortical thickness (volumetric MRI/cortical thickness) analyses rather than one of the imaging modalities required by inclusion (VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET). Exclusion criterion E9 (only reports cortical thickness methods) therefore applies. Inclusion criteria satisfied: I4 (clinically diagnosed bvFTD sample present) and I5 (sample sizes: 17 bvFTD, 22 controls). Inclusion criteria not satisfied: I3 (required imaging modality VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET; cortical thickness is not listed), I6 (unclear/absent explicit reporting of between-group contrast results in a standard MNI/Talairach space in the provided text), and I8 (no peak coordinates reported in the provided full text for any whole-brain bvFTD-versus-control contrast). Full text appears otherwise complete, but the absence of reported peak coordinates and the use of cortical thickness analysis lead to exclusion under E9.

This study is excluded because it does not meet the imaging-modality and whole-brain voxelwise coordinate reporting requirements. It used structural ROI volumetry (FreeSurfer regional gray-matter volumes), not VBM, task/resting fMRI, or FDG-PET (I3 not met). The paper does not report any whole-brain, voxelwise bvFTD-versus-control contrasts or peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space (I6, I7, I8 not met). Full text appears complete (methods, results, discussion present).

Although this study meets several inclusion criteria (uses VBM; includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients; has sufficient sample sizes; reports whole-brain voxelwise group contrasts including bvFTD vs. controls), the provided full text does not report any peak coordinates (x,y,z in MNI or Talairach space) for bvFTD-versus-control or other whole-brain contrasts. Inclusion criterion I8 (reporting actual peak coordinates for at least one whole-brain bvFTD-versus-control contrast) is therefore not satisfied. No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) are triggered by the presented material. Full text appears complete (introduction, methods, results, discussion), so fulltext_incomplete is false.

Although this study uses voxel-based morphometry (VBM) and includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients within a large neurodegenerative sample (satisfying I3, I4, I5), it does not report any whole-brain, voxelwise bvFTD-versus-control group contrasts nor provide peak coordinates for such a contrast. The bvFTD-specific analyses reported are restricted ROI analyses within the insula and main VBM results relate to presence of disgusting behaviors and disgust recognition across a heterogeneous patient sample rather than an explicit bvFTD vs control whole-brain comparison. Therefore inclusion criteria I6, I7, and I8 are not met. This falls under exclusion criterion E6 (results for the target group are only ROI-confined and no unrestricted whole-brain bvFTD-vs-control voxelwise result with coordinates is reported). Full text appears complete for screening purposes.

This study should be excluded. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (uses FDG-PET) and I4 (includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients). Inclusion criteria NOT met: I5 (bvFTD patient group size = 4, below the required ≥6), I6 (no reported group-level between-group contrast of bvFTD vs controls in standard space — analyses are single-subject comparisons), I7 (no group-level whole-brain voxelwise result from the bvFTD group is reported), and I8 (no peak coordinates for a bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast are provided). No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) from the list are triggered by this paper. Full text appears complete (includes introduction, methods, results, discussion). Therefore the paper does not satisfy all required inclusion criteria and is excluded.

The paper meets several inclusion criteria (uses voxel-based morphometry; includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients; sample sizes meet thresholds; reports between-group contrasts and whole-brain voxelwise analyses). If the supplementary material or full tables with coordinates are provided, this decision should be reassessed.

Full text is complete. The study uses voxel-based morphometry (VBM) and includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD subgroup (n=12) with a healthy control group (n=30). The authors report whole-brain, voxelwise VBM contrasts comparing the bvFTD subgroup to controls. However, the provided full text does not report any peak coordinates (x,y,z in MNI or Talairach space) for the bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrasts; no coordinate table or captioned peaks are present in the main text. Because Inclusion Criterion I8 (reporting of peak coordinates) is not satisfied in the provided article text, the study cannot be included for this coordinate-based meta-analysis. This study meets many inclusion criteria: it used voxel-based morphometry and task/resting-state fMRI (I3); included clinically diagnosed behavioural-variant FTD patients (I4); patient and control groups meet the minimum sample sizes (I5); it reports whole-brain between-group voxelwise contrasts in MNI space (I6,I7).
