Inclusion criterion I8 (presence of reported peak coordinates) cannot be verified from the supplied material. Because I8 is not satisfied and the supplied article content appears to omit key tables/coordinate listings, I mark the full text as incomplete and exclude the paper pending access to the complete text or supplementary tables containing peak coordinates.

This is an empirical multimodal imaging study that includes 11 bvFTD patients and uses VBM, resting-state fMRI (degree centrality), and FDG-PET (I3, I4, I5 satisfied). However, the paper does not report any group-level, whole-brain (voxelwise) contrasts of bvFTD versus controls nor peak coordinates from such contrasts. The analyses focus on ROI-derived voxelwise measures from predefined network cores and SVM classification between patient groups; results are reported as classification accuracies rather than standard whole-brain/between-group statistical maps with peak coordinates. Therefore it fails inclusion criteria I6, I7, and I8, and meets exclusion criterion E6 (qualifying results come from ROI-based analyses without unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise bvFTD-vs-control contrasts). Full text appears complete. Hence the study must be excluded.

This study uses FDG-PET and includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group (n=13), but it does not report any whole-brain voxelwise between-group contrasts in stereotactic (MNI/Talairach) space nor does it provide peak coordinates. PET data were reported as regional hypometabolism ratings (ordinal scores) and correlations by region, not as voxelwise coordinate results. Therefore it fails inclusion criteria I6, I7, and I8 and meets exclusion criterion E6 (qualifying results come from regional/ROI-style ratings with no unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise result). Full text appears complete.

This paper meets most inclusion criteria (I3, I4, I5, I6, I7): it uses resting-state fMRI and voxel-based morphometry (I3); includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients (n=21) and healthy controls (n=33) (I4,I5); reports whole-brain VBM group-level contrasts comparing bvFTD subgroups to controls (I6,I7). However, the provided full text does not report any explicit peak coordinates (x,y,z in MNI or Talairach) for any whole-brain bvFTD-versus-control contrast (I8 not met). Peak coordinates appear to be referenced to supplementary tables (e.g., Supplementary Table 1) that were not included here; without confirmed reported coordinates in the available text/supplement, I8 fails. No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) apply based on the provided content. Therefore the study must be excluded for the meta-analysis because it does not satisfy I8 (peak coordinates unavailable in the provided material).

The study uses VBM (I3) and includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group (n=13) with adequate sample sizes including controls (I4, I5). However, the VBM results reported are correlational analyses in a combined patient cohort and significant findings were observed only within pre-specified regional volumes of interest (ROI), not as whole-brain voxelwise bvFTD-versus-control contrasts. The paper does not report any whole-brain, group-level bvFTD vs. control voxelwise results nor does it provide peak coordinates for such a contrast. Therefore it fails to meet I6, I7 and I8 and its qualifying imaging results are ROI-restricted (E6).

Study meets several inclusion criteria: uses voxel-based morphometry (VBM) on structural MRI (I3); includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD sample (n=14) (I4); reports adequate sample sizes for bvFTD and controls (I5); and describes whole-brain, voxelwise between-group SPM contrasts of bvFTD vs. controls (I6,I7). This full text reports whole-brain voxel-based morphometry (VBM) analyses including direct comparisons of bvFTD patients (n=49) versus healthy controls (n=27). Imaging modality: VBM (I3). Sample includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD participants (I4) with sufficient sample size (>6) and controls (>6) (I5). The paper presents between-group contrasts for bvFTD versus controls and states that whole-brain VBM results and peak coordinates in MNI space are provided for clusters (the manuscript explicitly notes ‘Montreal Neurological Institute coordinates (x, y, z) given for maximum T-score for the cluster’), satisfying reporting of group-level voxelwise results and coordinates (I6, I7, I8). The full text includes Introduction, Methods, Results (neuroimaging contrasts), and Discussion; it appears complete. No exclusion criteria (e.g., ROI-only, review, inappropriate sample) are met.

This study meets several inclusion criteria: I3 (used voxel-based morphometry), I4 (included clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients), I5 (sample sizes: 51 bvFTD, 14 controls), I6 (performed between-group contrasts of patient groups vs controls), and I7 (reports whole-brain voxelwise group-level results). However, the provided full text does not report any peak coordinates (x,y,z in MNI or Talairach) for bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrasts in the main text; coordinates appear to be referenced in supplemental Table e-1 but are not present in the supplied content. Because inclusion criterion I8 (explicit peak coordinates for at least one whole-brain bvFTD-vs-control contrast) is not satisfied in the provided material, the study must be excluded. Although the paper uses VBM (I3), includes a clinically diagnosed frontal-variant FTD group (FTD-fv, equivalent to bvFTD) (I4), has adequate patient and control sample sizes (25 FTD-fv; 14 controls) (I5), and reports whole-brain, voxelwise group analyses comparing the FTD-fv group to controls (I6, I7), it does not report explicit peak coordinates for any whole-brain FTD-fv versus control contrast (I8 not met). The manuscript provides MNI coordinates for correlations within patient groups (e.g., ZBI correlations and a figure crosshair center) but does not supply peak (x,y,z) coordinates for a bvFTD-vs-control between-group contrast in the text, tables, or captions. Therefore it fails inclusion criterion I8 and must be excluded.

This full-text is excluded because it does not meet key imaging and analysis criteria required by the review. Inclusion criteria met: I4 (clinically diagnosed behavioral-variant FTD patients included) and I5 (patient group size ≥6; 63 FTD patients). Inclusion criteria NOT met: I3 (study does not employ VBM, task/resting fMRI, or clearly-specified FDG-PET voxelwise modality; PET/SPECT are reported clinically but not specified as FDG-PET and used as visual clinical reads), I6 (no between-group contrast reported in a defined stereotactic space comparing bvFTD versus controls), I7 (no group-level whole-brain voxelwise results reported), and I8 (no peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach reported). This study meets all inclusion criteria: it used voxel-based morphometry (VBM) (I3), included clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients (I4) with adequate group sizes (15 patients per bvFTD subgroup; 45 controls) satisfying the minimum sample requirement (I5), and reports whole-brain, group-level voxelwise contrasts (each bvFTD stage vs controls) with familywise-error correction (I7). The manuscript references MNI coordinates (figure captions note MNI coordinates) and an eTable of regions of gray matter loss (available/supplementary), indicating peak coordinates for reported contrasts (I6, I8). The full text contains introduction, methods, results, and discussion, so is complete for screening. No exclusion criteria are met (no ROI-only analyses, no predominant non-bvFTD sample, not a review, and uses acceptable imaging modality).

The study meets several inclusion criteria: it uses voxel-based morphometry (I3), includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients (I4), has sufficient sample sizes in patient and control groups (I5), and reports whole-brain, voxelwise group-level results identified for the target sample (I7). However, the provided full text does not report peak coordinates (x,y,z in MNI or Talairach space) for any bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast; coordinates shown in the manuscript are for voxelwise correlations with prosocial giving, not for the between-group atrophy contrast. Therefore it fails I8 (coordinates must exist) and consequently I6 (between-group contrast reported in a defined stereotactic space with coordinates). No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) are triggered by the provided text. Because I8 (and I6) are not satisfied, the study must be excluded from the coordinate-based meta-analysis. The study includes bvFTD patients (n=10) and uses relevant imaging modalities (task-based fMRI and voxel-based morphometry) with an adequate control group, satisfying I3, I4, and I5. However, imaging results for bvFTD are not reported separately: structural VBM analyses combined bvFTD and PNFA into a single patient group, and no whole-brain, between-group contrast comparing bvFTD alone versus controls is reported with peak coordinates. Therefore inclusion criteria I6, I7, and I8 are not met (no bvFTD-specific whole-brain contrast or coordinates). Full text appears complete. No exclusion criteria from the list (E5–E9) are triggered. Although this is an empirical study that includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients (n=72), uses voxelwise structural MRI (VBM-style W-score maps) and resting-state fMRI, and reports whole-brain group-level atrophy maps for the bvFTD group, the full text does not provide any peak coordinates (x,y,z in MNI or Talairach space) for a bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast. Therefore it fails the required coordinate reporting criterion (I8). I3, I4, I5, and I7 are satisfied; I6 and I8 are not satisfied (no explicit between-group peak-coordinate table/report in stereotaxic space). No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) are met. Full text appears complete.

Exclusion(s) met: E6 - study uses region-of-interest manual volumetric measurements (ROI-based cortical and amygdala volumes) and does NOT report unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise results; no VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET analysis. Inclusion(s) met: I4 - sample includes clinically diagnosed FTD patients (frontal-variant fvFTD cases mapping onto behavioral-variant FTD) and semantic dementia; I5 - sample sizes exceed thresholds (49–51 FTD patients and 20 controls). Inclusion(s) not met: I3 - imaging modality is ROI volumetry (manual segmentation), not VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET; I6 - no between-group contrast reported in standard stereotactic space comparing bvFTD to controls; I7 - no group-level whole-brain (voxelwise) results from the target sample; I8 - no peak MNI/Talairach coordinates are reported. Full text appears complete. Conclusion: Exclude because imaging modality and reporting format do not meet required whole-brain voxelwise/coordinate-based criteria (I3,I6,I7,I8) and the results are ROI-based (E6).

Summary: This study examines temporal-variant FTD (semantic dementia) using manual ROI-based MRI volumetry in a cohort of predominantly tvFTD patients (left and right temporal variants). Exclusion criteria met: E6 (results derive from region-of-interest/manual ROI volume analyses rather than whole-brain, voxelwise VBM/FDG-PET/fMRI results) and E7 (the patient group is temporal-variant FTD, not behavioral-variant FTD or Pick’s disease; bvFTD cases are not the target and cannot be separated). Inclusion criteria met: I5 (patient group size ≥6; the analyzed tvFTD sample includes 12 patients and control group present). Inclusion criteria not met: I3 (imaging modality is manual structural MRI ROI, not VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET), I4 (sample does not consist of clinically diagnosed bvFTD or Pick’s disease), I6 (no between-group voxelwise contrast in standard stereotactic space comparing bvFTD to controls), I7 (no whole-brain, voxelwise group-level results for bvFTD), I8 (no peak coordinates reported in MNI/Talairach space). Full text completeness: fulltext_incomplete = false (core article content present). Conclusion: Excluded because imaging modality and analytic approach do not match required modalities/whole-brain coordinate reporting, and the clinical sample is temporal-variant FTD rather than bvFTD/Pick’s disease.

This study is excluded because the reported patient group labeled FTLD pools multiple clinical subtypes (FTD [n=4], semantic dementia [n=5], mixed [n=2]) and does not provide results specifically for a bvFTD (behavioral-variant FTD) group. Although the study used appropriate imaging modalities (FDG-PET and VBM) and the FTLD sample size (n=11) exceeds the minimum, the key meta-analysis requirements are not met: (a) no bvFTD-specific between-group contrasts (bvFTD vs. controls) are reported (I6 not met), (b) no whole-brain group-level result is clearly identified as coming solely from a bvFTD sample (I7 not met), and (c) no peak coordinates for a bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast are provided in the supplied text (I8 not met). Thus the bvFTD cases are not separable from other FTLD subtypes in the presented contrasts, meeting exclusion criterion E7. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (FDG-PET and VBM) and I5 (patient group size ≥6). Inclusion criteria not met: I4 (bvFTD-specific sample/results), I6, I7, I8. Full text appears complete for core sections; however, no bvFTD-specific coordinate data are reported here.

The study meets several inclusion criteria: it uses VBM (I3); includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group (n=11) (I4); has adequate group sizes (bvFTD n=11, controls n=8) (I5); reports between-group VBM contrasts for bvFTD versus controls (I6); and presents whole-brain voxelwise results identified by diagnostic group (I7). Decision based solely on the supplied full-text content; if the missing tables (e.g., Table 4 or Table 1) contain coordinates, re-screening with that material could change this decision.

The study uses voxel-based morphometry and reports whole-brain bvFTD vs control VBM contrasts, but the provided full text does not report peak coordinates (x,y,z) for any bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast in MNI or Talairach space. The study meets several inclusion criteria: I3 (uses voxel-based morphometry), I4 (includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD subjects), I5 (bvFTD group and controls exceed 6 participants), I6 (reports between-group voxelwise contrasts vs. controls), and I7 (reports whole-brain voxelwise group-level results). The study meets multiple inclusion criteria: it uses voxel-based morphometry and FDG-PET (I3), includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients per Rascovsky criteria (I4), has sufficient sample sizes (15 patients, 15 controls) (I5), reports between-group whole-brain voxelwise contrasts comparing the bvFTD group to controls (I6), and presents group-level whole-brain voxelwise results from the target bvFTD sample (I7). This study is excluded because it does not meet multiple required inclusion criteria for the review. Inclusion criteria met: I4 (includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients) and I7 (reports group-level, whole-brain voxelwise bvFTD-versus-control comparisons). Inclusion criteria not met: I3 (imaging modality is F-THK5351 PET, not VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET), I5 (bvFTD sample size = 3, below the required minimum of 6), I6 (no between-group contrast results reported in a defined stereotactic space such as MNI or Talairach), and I8 (no peak coordinates provided for any whole-brain bvFTD-versus-control contrast). No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) were triggered. Full text appears complete. Because failing any single inclusion criterion requires exclusion, the study must be excluded.

Exclusion ID E6 applies: the study's significant neuroimaging findings (associations of face identification and anger recognition with grey matter) are reported after small-volume correction (SVC) within prespecified anatomical regions rather than as unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise bvFTD-versus-control contrasts. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (used VBM), I4 (included clinically diagnosed bvFTD subgroup of 19 patients), I5 (patient group and control group sizes ≥6). Inclusion criteria NOT met: I6 (no reported between-group voxelwise contrast of bvFTD vs controls unpooled from other patients), I7 (no group-level whole-brain voxelwise result reported for the bvFTD group), I8 (no peak coordinates reported for a whole-brain bvFTD-versus-control contrast). Full text appears complete (supplementary material missing but acceptable). Therefore the study must be excluded from the meta-analysis.

This study uses task-based fMRI in a clinically diagnosed bvFTD sample (15 patients) with an age-matched healthy control group (11), and reports between-group voxelwise contrasts (controls vs bvFTD) including at least one whole-brain FWE result ((MCM > MFC) × (controls > bvFTD) in dorsal brainstem). Thus I3, I4, I5, I6, and I7 are satisfied. However, the provided full text does not include any peak coordinates (x,y,z in MNI or Talairach space) for any whole-brain bvFTD-versus-control contrast; coordinates appear to be referenced in a Table/Figure that is not included here. Therefore inclusion criterion I8 (reporting of peak coordinates) is not met. No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) apply. Full text appears complete (introduction, methods, results, discussion present). Because ALL inclusion criteria must be met and I8 is not satisfied, the study is excluded.

This study meets all required inclusion criteria: it uses FDG-PET (I3); includes clinically diagnosed frontal-variant/bvFTD patients per Neary criteria (I4) with N=22 patients and N=15 healthy controls (I5); reports voxelwise, whole-brain SPM analyses comparing the FTD group to controls (I7) with peak coordinates reported in Talairach space (e.g., -9/20/27 and -7/32/27) satisfying both between-group contrast and coordinate reporting requirements (I6, I8). No exclusion criteria are met (not a review, not ROI-only, not seed-based FC/DTI/cortical thickness). Full text appears complete (introduction, methods, results, discussion present).

The study uses VBM/TBM methods (I3) and includes an FTD patient group of N=30 (I5) and reports whole-brain SPM comparisons (I7). However, the paper does not explicitly state that the FTD cases are behavioral-variant FTD or Pick's disease (I4 not satisfied in the provided text). Additionally, the provided full text does not report any peak coordinates (MNI or Talairach) for an FTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast (I6 and I8 not satisfied). No exclusion criteria from the list apply. Therefore the study must be excluded because it fails to meet required inclusion criteria I4, I6, and I8.

This study is excluded because it does not meet all required inclusion criteria for the review. Satisfied criteria: I3 (uses FDG‑PET), I4 (includes clinically diagnosed frontal variant/frontotemporal dementia patients equivalent to bvFTD), I5 (patient and control groups each ≥6), and I7 (reports whole‑brain, voxelwise group-level results identified for the fv‑FTD patient group via SPM). Not satisfied: I6 and I8. The paper does not report any between‑group, whole‑brain voxelwise contrast comparing the bvFTD/fv‑FTD group directly against controls (I6 is not met), and it does not provide peak coordinates for a bvFTD‑versus‑control whole‑brain contrast (I8 is not met). The imaging results presented are within‑group correlations between fluency scores and FDG uptake rather than voxelwise bvFTD>control contrasts with reported MNI/Talairach peak coordinates. No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) apply. Full text appears complete.

Although this is an empirical VBM study with whole-brain between-group contrasts and adequate sample sizes, it does not report any peak coordinates (x,y,z in MNI/Talairach) for bvFTD-versus-control contrasts. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (VBM used), I5 (≥6 patients and controls), I6 (between-group contrast of ALS-FTD vs controls), I7 (whole-brain voxelwise results). Inclusion criteria not met: I4 (study population is ALS-FTD; it is not explicitly stated that cases are diagnosed as behavioral-variant FTD/bvFTD), I8 (no peak coordinates reported). No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) are triggered. Full text appears complete (background, methods, results, discussion, conclusion). Therefore EXCLUDED for failing required coordinate reporting (I8) and unclear bvFTD-specific diagnosis (I4).

This empirical study used voxel-based morphometry (VBM) to compare bvFTD patients to controls and reports whole-brain, group-level voxelwise contrasts with peak coordinates in MNI space (see Table 2). The sample includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients (N=26) and controls (N=16), satisfying minimum sample-size requirements. The full text contains methods, results, and discussion supporting the VBM contrasts. No exclusion criteria (e.g., ROI-only analyses, non-empirical paper, wrong modality) apply. Therefore the study meets all required inclusion criteria and is suitable for inclusion in the meta-analysis.

Although this study uses resting-state fMRI (I3), includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD cases within the sample (7 bvFTD cases) (I4), and has adequate group sizes (FTD N=14, controls N≈16) (I5), it does not report any between-group voxelwise contrast that isolates the bvFTD subgroup versus controls. The reported whole-brain results and peak coordinates are for combined GRN+ FTD patients (mixed bvFTD and avPPA) or for GRN-carrier vs controls analyses, not for a bvFTD-only vs control contrast. Thus criteria I6, I7 and I8 are not met. Because the bvFTD cases are not separable from other FTD phenotypes in the reported contrasts, exclusion criterion E7 applies. Full text appears complete (fulltext_incomplete=false).

Exclusion reason: This study is EXCLUDED because it reports region-of-interest volumetric analyses (basal forebrain volumes extracted with GIF) rather than whole-brain voxelwise analyses and does not provide any peak coordinates. Specifically, it meets exclusion criterion E6 (qualifying result comes from an ROI analysis). Inclusion criteria met: I4 (includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients) and I5 (sample sizes meet minimum: bvFTD n=148, controls n=83). Inclusion criteria not met: I3 (imaging modality is T1-weighted structural MRI volumetry, not VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET), I6 (no between-group voxelwise contrast in stereotactic space reported for bvFTD vs controls), I7 (no whole-brain voxelwise group-level result), I8 (no peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space). Full text appears complete (fulltext_incomplete=false).

This study is excluded because it does not report whole-brain, voxelwise peak coordinates for a bvFTD-versus-control contrast and the patient group analyzed is a mixed FTD cohort rather than a bvFTD-only group. Exclusion criteria met: E6 (the reported results are ROI-wise/classification summaries without reported unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise peak coordinates). Inclusion criteria satisfied: I3 (VBM was used) and I5 (sample sizes: FTD n=37 and controls present, both ≥6). Inclusion criteria not satisfied: I4 (the paper analyzes a heterogeneous FTD group and does not present results specifically for a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group), I6 (no reported between-group contrast in MNI/Talairach coordinates for a bvFTD-only group), I7 (no clearly reported group-level, whole-brain voxelwise result specifically identified as coming from a bvFTD sample), and I8 (no peak coordinates provided for any bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast). Therefore it does not meet all required inclusion criteria for the bvFTD coordinate-based review.

This study uses VBM and includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group (bvFTD n=10) and controls (n=10), and reports whole-brain voxelwise group contrasts for bvFTD versus controls. However, the provided full text does not report any peak coordinates (x,y,z in MNI or Talairach space) for bvFTD-versus-control contrasts in the main text. Although figures and supplementary materials are referenced, no coordinates were included in the supplied content. Therefore inclusion criterion I8 (required peak coordinates) is not met, so the study must be excluded. (Inclusion criteria met: I3, I4, I5, I6, I7. Inclusion criterion not met: I8. Exclusion criteria met: none.)

While this paper uses FDG-PET and VBM (I3), includes clinically-diagnosed bvFTD symptomatic carriers (I4), and has adequate group sizes (8 symptomatic bvFTD patients and 8 controls; I5), it does NOT report a whole-brain, voxelwise contrast that isolates the bvFTD (symptomatic) group versus controls. The voxelwise analyses are reported for ‘mutation carriers’ (symptomatic and asymptomatic combined) versus non-carriers, and the authors state the three-group (SC, AC, NC) sample sizes were too small for voxel-based analysis. Therefore the study fails to meet I6 and I7. Additionally, no peak coordinates for a bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast are presented in the provided text (I8 not met). No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) apply. Full text appears complete (methods, results, discussion present).

This study is excluded. Inclusion criteria met: I4 (patients diagnosed using Neary criteria for FTD, consistent with behavioral-variant features) and I5 (patient group sizes: 12 FTD, 13 semantic dementia, 24 controls). Inclusion criteria NOT met: I3 (imaging modality is volumetric MRI segmentation, not VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET), I6 (no between-group voxelwise contrasts in MNI/Talairach reported for bvFTD), I7 (no group-level whole-brain voxelwise result for the target bvFTD sample), I8 (no peak coordinates reported). Exclusion criteria met: E6 (results are regional/lobar volumetric comparisons—per-region averages—without unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise contrasts). Full text appears complete (methods, results, discussion present). Therefore the paper does not provide the required voxelwise coordinate-based whole-brain data for inclusion in this meta-analysis.

This study is EXCLUDED because it does not provide results specific to clinically diagnosed behavioral-variant FTD (bvFTD) and does not report peak coordinates for any bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (uses VBM). Inclusion criteria NOT met: I4 (participants are genetic FTD mutation carriers but not specified/isolated as clinically diagnosed bvFTD), I5 (the bvFTD-specific patient group is not defined so bvFTD sample-size criterion cannot be confirmed), I6 (no reported between-group contrast in MNI/Talairach space specific to a bvFTD group), I7 (no clearly identified whole-brain voxelwise result coming from a bvFTD target group), I8 (no peak coordinates reported in the text). No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) apply. Full text appears complete.

Although the study uses voxel-based morphometry (VBM) and includes a clinically diagnosed FTD (bvFTD) sample with adequate sample size and healthy controls, it does not provide the required group-level, whole-brain bvFTD-versus-control voxelwise contrasts with reported peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space. The paper primarily describes single-subject/subject-versus-normative-database SPMs (normative brain volume reports) and presents diagnostic accuracy and example renderings, but no bvFTD group-level voxelwise results or peak coordinate tables are reported. Therefore inclusion criteria I6, I7, and I8 are not met. No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) apply.

Although this paper includes VBM analyses and reports group comparisons between bvFTD and controls, the full text provided does NOT report any peak coordinates (MNI or Talairach) for bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrasts. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (VBM used), I4 (bvFTD sample present), I5 (bvFTD n=22; controls n=34), I6 (between-group contrasts were performed and scans were registered to MNI space), and I7 (whole-brain voxelwise VBM analyses are described). Inclusion criterion NOT met: I8 — no actual peak (x,y,z) coordinates are reported in the main text, tables, or figure captions provided; coordinates appear to be only in online supplementary material (not included here). No exclusion criteria from the list (E5–E9) were triggered based on the provided text. Because I8 is mandatory and not satisfied in the available full text, the study must be excluded.

This study meets several inclusion criteria (uses VBM; clinically diagnosed bvFTD sample; sufficient sample sizes; reports whole-brain group-level VBM contrast bvFTD vs controls). However, the provided full text does not report any peak coordinates (x,y,z in MNI or Talairach) for the whole-brain bvFTD-versus-control contrasts in the main text, figures, or supplementary material included here. Inclusion criterion I8 explicitly requires reporting of peak coordinates for at least one whole-brain bvFTD-versus-control contrast. Because that criterion is not met in the provided content, the study cannot be included for the coordinate-based meta-analysis. No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) apply based on the provided information. Full text appears complete for main content (intro, methods, results, discussion); lack of reported coordinates prevents inclusion.

This fMRI study of 128 FTD patients (81 bvFTD, 47 PPA) uses resting-state dynamic functional connectivity and reports correlations with education. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (resting-state fMRI used), I4 (bvFTD patients included), and I5 (patient group size ≥6). However it fails key meta-analysis requirements: no healthy control group or bvFTD-vs-control between-group contrast is reported (I6 not met), no group-level whole-brain voxelwise bvFTD-versus-control results are provided (I7 not met), and no peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space for any bvFTD-versus-control contrast are reported (I8 not met). No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) apply. Therefore the study must be excluded because it does not provide the required between-group whole-brain coordinate-based contrasts comparing bvFTD to controls.

Although this study includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients (n=24), uses VBM, and reports whole-brain voxelwise group comparisons versus controls, the provided full text does not report peak coordinates (MNI or Talairach x,y,z) for any bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast. Inclusion criteria I3 (VBM used), I4 (bvFTD sample), I5 (sample sizes ≥6), I6 (between-group contrast bvFTD vs controls), and I7 (whole-brain group-level voxelwise results for the target group) are satisfied. However, I8 (reporting of peak coordinates for at least one whole-brain bvFTD-versus-control contrast) is not satisfied in the available text. No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) apply. Therefore the study must be excluded from the meta-analysis per the requirement for reported peak coordinates. Full text appears complete for main article sections (fulltext_incomplete=false).

This study is excluded because it does not provide the required whole-brain, voxelwise peak coordinates from a clinically-diagnosed bvFTD (behavioral-variant FTD) group. Specifically, the paper reports multimodal SVM classification (whole-brain and ROI-based) using FDG-PET and MRI in a cohort labeled as FTLD, but does not specify that the patient group is bvFTD (or Pick’s disease) and does not report MNI/Talairach peak coordinates for any bvFTD-versus-control voxelwise contrast. The key reported results are classification accuracies and ROI-based analyses; no unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise contrasts with peak coordinates are provided. Therefore it fails the bvFTD-specific sample and coordinate-reporting inclusion criteria and meets exclusion E6 (no unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise result / ROI-only qualifying result).

This study does not address the review target population (bvFTD). Inclusion criteria met: I3 (VBM was used) and I5 (patient and control groups have ≥6 participants: SV-PPA n=10, AD n=18, NC n=67). Inclusion criteria not met: I4 (does not include clinically diagnosed bvFTD or Pick’s disease patients), I6 (no between-group contrast comparing a bvFTD group to controls is reported), I7 (no whole-brain group-level voxelwise result identified as coming from a bvFTD sample), and I8 (no peak coordinates for a bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast are reported). No exclusion criteria from the provided list directly apply (e.g., this is an empirical VBM study and not an ROI-only, review, or non-bvFTD pooled contrast). Because key inclusion criteria requiring a bvFTD sample and bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain coordinates are not met, the paper must be excluded from the bvFTD meta-analysis.

This study uses FDG-PET (I3) in a clinically diagnosed frontal-variant FTD sample corresponding to bvFTD (I4), includes sufficient participants (13 patients, controls ≥6) (I5), and reports group-level whole-brain voxelwise correlations within the fv-FTD patient group (I7). However, it does NOT report any between-group (bvFTD vs. controls) whole-brain voxelwise contrast in MNI/Talairach space (I6 not met). Additionally, the provided full text does not present explicit peak coordinates (x,y,z) for voxelwise contrasts (I8 not met). No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) appear to apply. Therefore the study is excluded because it fails to meet inclusion criteria I6 and I8.

This study uses resting-state fMRI (I3 met), includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD participants (18 bvFTD cases; I4 met), and has adequate patient group sizes (I5 met). However, it does not report any between-group voxelwise contrasts comparing a bvFTD group to healthy controls (no bvFTD-versus-control contrasts), and the reported voxelwise results are within-group regressions across a mixed FTD sample (bvFTD + avPPA) or comparisons between GRN+ and GRN- groups. Thus inclusion criteria I6, I7, and I8 are not met (no bvFTD-vs-control whole-brain contrast with peak coordinates). The bvFTD cases are not separable in the reported contrasts, triggering exclusion criterion E7. Full text appears complete. Therefore the paper must be excluded.

This study does not meet the review’s target sample and contrast requirements. Strengths: it uses voxel-based morphometry–style whole-brain voxelwise MRI analyses and reports peak voxels (I3 satisfied). However, the imaging subgroup contrasts are reported for pathologically defined subgroups (tau-positive FTD, tau-negative FTD, frontal-variant AD), not for a clinically diagnosed behavioral-variant FTD (bvFTD) or Pick’s disease group; the paper does not present a bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast with peak coordinates (I4, I6, I7, I8 not met). In addition, the imaging patient subgroups contain fewer than 6 participants (n=5, n=4, n=3), failing the sample-size requirement (I5 not met). No exclusion criteria from E5–E9 are triggered. Therefore the study must be excluded because it fails multiple required inclusion criteria (sample definition, sample size, and bvFTD-specific whole-brain coordinate contrasts).

The study uses volumetric MRI measures (BBSI, VBSI) rather than VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET, so it fails inclusion criterion I3. It also does not report any voxelwise whole-brain group-level contrasts or peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space, failing I6, I7, and I8. The full text appears complete. It does include clinically diagnosed bvFTD participants (I4) and meets the sample-size requirement (I5: bvFTD n=11, controls n=24). No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) are triggered. Therefore the paper does not meet all required inclusion criteria for the meta-analysis and is excluded.

The study uses VBM on a large genetic FTD cohort and reports whole-brain voxelwise correlations between neuropsychiatric symptom scores and grey matter within mutation groups. However, it does not present a clinically diagnosed bvFTD patient group contrasted against healthy controls, nor does it report any between-group bvFTD-versus-control voxelwise contrasts or peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space. Therefore it does not meet key inclusion requirements for this review focused on bvFTD case-control contrasts. Full text appears complete.

The study is excluded because it does not meet key inclusion criteria required for this review. It uses VBM (I3 met) and has adequate group sizes (I5 met), but the FTD group is not specified as behavioral-variant FTD or Pick’s disease (I4 not met). The paper does not report any whole-brain voxelwise between-group contrasts with peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach for a bvFTD-versus-control contrast (I6, I7, I8 not met). Instead, results are reported as region-level abnormal voxel volumes and ROC analyses across predefined ROIs; no peak coordinates are provided. Because the qualifying results are ROI-based rather than unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise contrasts, exclusion criterion E6 applies. Full text appears complete.

The full text reports use of voxel-based morphometry (VBM) alongside diffusion MRI (satisfies I3). The sample includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group (n=13) with matched healthy controls (satisfies I4 and I5). The paper describes group-level, whole-brain VBM analyses comparing bvFTD versus controls and refers to VBM results shown in Supplementary Tables/Figures (satisfies I6 and I7). Although peak coordinates are not printed in the body text excerpt provided, the manuscript explicitly references Supplementary Tables 4–7 for VBM results, which is an acceptable location for reported peak coordinates per the inclusion rules, so I8 is considered satisfied. No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) apply based on the provided content. Therefore the study meets all inclusion criteria for the review objective (bvFTD whole-brain VBM contrasts versus controls).

This study is excluded because it does not meet the required imaging and reporting criteria for the meta-analysis. Inclusion criteria met: I4 (includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients) and I5 (bvFTD cohort size exceeds 6). Inclusion criteria not met: I3 (did not use VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET — only structural MRI was reported), I6 (no between-group contrasts in MNI/Talairach space comparing bvFTD to controls are reported), I7 (no whole-brain voxelwise group-level results identified from the target bvFTD sample), and I8 (no peak coordinates reported for any bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast). No exclusion criteria from the list apply. Full text appears complete (methods, results, discussion present) so fulltext_incomplete=false.

This study is excluded because it does not report the required whole-brain, voxelwise bvFTD-versus-control contrasts with peak coordinates. Specifically: (a) Exclusion criteria met: none (no exclusion rule directly applies). (b) Inclusion criteria met: I3 (FDG-PET used), I4 (sample includes clinically diagnosed FTD with behavioral-variant criteria applied), I5 (FTD patient group N=36 ≥6). (c) Inclusion criteria not met: I6 (no clearly reported between-group contrast in MNI/Talairach space comparing a bvFTD group to controls is presented), I7 (no whole-brain, group-level voxelwise result identified as coming from the bvFTD sample is reported), I8 (no peak coordinates are provided for any bvFTD-versus-control voxelwise contrast). The full text appears complete and contains methods and voxelwise analysis descriptions, but the necessary coordinate tables or explicit bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain statistical maps/peak coordinates are not provided, so the paper cannot contribute coordinates for meta-analysis.

The study is excluded because its MRI analysis is not a whole-brain voxelwise neuroimaging modality and does not report stereotactic peak coordinates. Exclusion criteria met: E6 (results derive from regional/ROI-style MRI measures and no unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise results are reported). Inclusion criteria satisfied: I5 (sample sizes: 41 FTD patients and 121 AD comparators, both >6). Inclusion criteria not met: I3 (did not use VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET; used structural MRI measurements/ratios), I4 (paper reports clinically diagnosed FTD but does not explicitly state behavioral-variant FTD or Pick’s disease), I6 (no between-group contrast reported in MNI/Talairach stereotactic space), I7 (no group-level whole-brain voxelwise results), I8 (no peak coordinates reported). Full text appears complete (fulltext_incomplete=false).

Although this empirical study uses VBM (voxel-based morphometry) and reports voxelwise, whole-brain contrasts for a clinically diagnosed bvFTD subgroup versus controls with adequate sample sizes (bvFTD n=13, controls n=19), the provided full text does not include any peak coordinates (x,y,z in MNI or Talairach) for the bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrasts. Inclusion criterion I8 (reporting of peak coordinates) is therefore not satisfied based on the text supplied. No exclusion criteria apply. Because the meta-analysis requires reported stereotactic peak coordinates for inclusion, this study must be excluded unless coordinates can be located in the main text, supplements, or tables not present here.

This study includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients and uses whole-brain VBM and task fMRI with adequate group sizes, but it does not report any voxelwise between-group contrast comparing bvFTD versus healthy controls with peak coordinates. The VBM results reported are AD versus bvFTD (and bvFTD versus AD), not bvFTD versus controls; behavioral contrasts compare patients to controls but imaging contrasts of interest do not present a bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast with coordinates. Therefore inclusion criteria I6 and I8 are not met, so the study must be excluded.

The study reports voxel-based morphometry (VBM) analyses of a genetic group (C9ORF72 mutation carriers, n=11) compared to controls rather than analyses of a clinically defined bvFTD group. While many C9ORF72 cases had bvFTD diagnoses, the reported between-group contrasts are mutation-group versus controls (not bvFTD-only versus controls), and the paper does not present any whole-brain, group-level voxelwise contrast that is explicitly from a bvFTD-only sample. Additionally, no peak coordinates for any bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrasts are provided in the full text. Therefore the paper meets I3 (VBM used) but fails to meet I4 (bvFTD sample contrast), I6 (bvFTD-versus-control contrast not provided), I7 (no whole-brain group-level result clearly identified as bvFTD), and I8 (no peak coordinates for a bvFTD contrast). No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) are triggered. Full text appears complete.

This paper meets multiple inclusion criteria (VBM used; clinically-diagnosed bvFTD group analyzed separately; patient and control groups exceed N=6; group-level two-sample voxelwise contrasts vs. controls are reported; whole-brain voxelwise group results are described). However the provided full text does not include any numeric peak coordinates (x,y,z in MNI or Talairach space) for bvFTD-versus-control contrasts. Tables and figures are referenced (e.g., Table 3, Supplementary Table 1) but the actual coordinate values are not present in the supplied content. Because Inclusion Criterion I8 (reporting of peak coordinates) is not satisfied based on the provided material, the study cannot be included. fulltext_incomplete is set to false because core article content (intro, methods, results, discussion) is present; the exclusion is solely due to missing reported coordinates in the available text.

This FDG-PET study includes clinically diagnosed FTD (behavioral-variant cases are described) and appears to have >=6 FTD patients, and uses FDG-PET (so I3, I4, I5 are satisfied). HOWEVER the paper reports only expert visual readings and diagnostic concordance; it does not present any whole-brain, voxelwise between-group contrasts in MNI/Talairach space, nor does it report peak coordinates for bvFTD-versus-control contrasts. Therefore it fails I6 (no between-group voxelwise contrast reported), I7 (no group-level whole-brain voxelwise result from the target bvFTD sample), and I8 (no peak coordinates provided). No exclusion criteria from E5–E9 are triggered. Because ALL inclusion criteria must be met and several are not, the study must be excluded.

This retrospective case series reports 18F-FDG PET (I3 satisfied) in a memory-clinic sample including 7 FTD patients, but it does NOT provide any group-level whole-brain bvFTD-versus-control voxelwise contrasts, nor does it report peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space. It also does not clearly disaggregate or confirm a clinically defined bvFTD subgroup with >=6 patients for between-group analysis. Therefore it fails to meet I4, I5, I6, I7, and I8. No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) are specifically met. Full text appears complete.

This study is excluded because it does not provide whole-brain voxelwise results or peak coordinates and uses hippocampal subfield volumetry derived from T1 structural MRI (regional/ROI volumetric analysis), not VBM, task/resting fMRI, or FDG-PET. Inclusion met: I4 (bvFTD patients are included within genetic groups) and I5 (>=6 patients and controls). Inclusion not met: I3 (required imaging modality VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET), I6 (no between-group contrast reported in MNI/Talairach space for bvFTD-vs-control), I7 (no group-level whole-brain voxelwise result for target group), and I8 (no reported peak coordinates). Exclusion criteria met: E6 (results derive from region-of-interest volumetry rather than unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise analysis). Full text appears complete.

Full text reports longitudinal voxelwise analyses of T1-weighted MRI (voxelwise gray-matter contraction maps) comparing bvFTD (n=44) to controls (n=97), and thus meets modality and sample-size criteria (I3, I4, I5). It reports whole-brain, group-level voxelwise results for bvFTD versus controls (I6, I7). However, the paper does not provide any peak coordinates (x,y,z in MNI/Talairach) for bvFTD-versus-control contrasts in the provided full text; no tables or figure captions with coordinates are present, so inclusion criterion I8 (reporting peak coordinates) is not met. No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) apply. Therefore the study must be excluded for failing I8.

This is a voxel-based morphometry study (I3 satisfied) with adequate patient and control group sizes (I5 satisfied). However, it does not include a clinically diagnosed behavioral-variant FTD (bvFTD) or Picks disease patient group (I4 not met). The paper reports pathology-defined groups (FTLD-tau, TDP43 subtypes) rather than a bvFTD clinical cohort, and no bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrasts or peak MNI/Talairach coordinates for a bvFTD group are reported (I6, I7, I8 not met). Therefore it fails the key inclusion criteria requiring a bvFTD clinical sample and bvFTD-specific whole-brain coordinate results. Full text appears complete. Inclusion criteria met: I3, I5. Inclusion criteria not met: I4, I6, I7, I8. Exclusion criteria: none applicable.

This study uses VBM and includes a clinically-diagnosed bvFTD group (n=12) and controls (n=21), satisfying imaging and sample-size criteria. However, the paper does not report any bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain voxelwise between-group contrasts with peak coordinates in MNI or Talairach space. The VBM results described are group-level correlations across the full sample and post-hoc region-wise comparisons (extraction at task-related voxels), not explicit whole-brain bvFTD>control voxelwise contrasts with reported peak coordinates. Therefore criteria I6, I7 and I8 (between-group voxelwise contrast for bvFTD vs controls and reported peak coordinates) are not met. Full text appears complete. No exclusion criteria from the provided list were triggered.

This is a single-family case report with one living, imaged bvFTD proband (and some mutation carriers without imaging abnormalities). Although FDG-PET (and ASL-MRI) was used and the proband is clinically diagnosed with bvFTD, the study does not include a patient group of at least 6 participants, contains no between-group bvFTD-versus-control voxelwise contrasts, reports no group-level whole-brain results, and provides no peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space. Therefore it fails inclusion criteria I5, I6, I7, and I8. Full text appears complete.

Although the study includes bvFTD patients (n=11), uses FDG‑PET, and has adequate control (n=13), it does NOT report any group-level whole-brain (voxelwise) bvFTD-versus-control contrasts or provide peak coordinates. The FDG‑PET work described is single-subject analyses (each patient vs. controls) yielding counts of hypometabolic voxels and representative images, but no unrestricted group-level voxelwise results or MNI/Talairach peak coordinates are provided. Therefore inclusion criteria I6, I7, and I8 are not met. Full text appears complete and empirical, so exclusion is based on failing required inclusion items rather than any exclusion criterion.

Excluded because key inclusion criteria for the meta-analysis are not met. The study does include clinically diagnosed behavioral-variant FTD (I4) and has adequate patient group size (39 FTD patients; I5). However, it does not present a standard mass-univariate VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET between-group contrast reporting peak coordinates in stereotactic space: analyses are based on SVM-derived weight maps rather than voxelwise group-level contrasts comparing bvFTD to healthy controls. Therefore criteria I3 (use of a qualifying modality/analysis as reported for VBM-style group contrasts), I6 (bvFTD vs. healthy control between-group contrast), I7 (clear whole-brain group-level voxelwise result from the bvFTD sample), and I8 (reported peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space) are not met. Full text appears complete (fulltext_incomplete=false).

Exclusion reason: E6 (study reports region-of-interest cerebellar volumetry without unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise results). Inclusion criteria met: I4 (sample includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD participants within genetic groups) and I5 (patient groups and control group each ≥6 participants). Inclusion criteria NOT met: I3 (modalities—study used structural ROI volumetry, not VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET), I6 (no between-group whole-brain voxelwise bvFTD-versus-control contrast reported; contrasts are genetic-mutation groups vs controls, not a bvFTD-only group contrast), I7 (no group-level whole-brain voxelwise results identified), I8 (no peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space reported). Full text appears complete (intro, methods, results, discussion). Therefore excluded because it is an ROI volumetry study and lacks whole-brain voxelwise coordinate-based contrasts required by the review.

The study is excluded because it does not meet key imaging and result-reporting inclusion criteria. Specifically, inclusion criterion I3 is not met: the imaging modality used is structural ROI-based volumetry (SABRE segmentation of T1 MRI and CSF/gray/white measurements) and multivariate PLS, not VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET. Inclusion criteria I6, I7, and I8 are also not met: the paper does not report any whole-brain voxelwise bvFTD-versus-control contrasts nor provide peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space for such contrasts (results are ROI-based and presented as regional volumes/bootstraps). The study does meet I4 (includes clinically diagnosed FTD patients, i.e., bvFTD/FTD group) and I5 (sample sizes: 22 patients, 16 controls). Exclusion criterion E6 applies because the qualifying results derive from region-of-interest analyses without unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise results. Full text appears complete (fulltext_incomplete=false).

I3 (VBM) met: study used voxel-based morphometry. I4 met: sample included clinically diagnosed bvFTD participants (n=15). I5 met: bvFTD group (15) and healthy control samples (12 in behavioral sample; 93 in imaging reference) exceed the N>=6 requirement. Inclusion criteria not met: I6 not met — the paper does not report any between-group VBM contrasts that directly compare a bvFTD-only group to controls (bvFTD results are not presented separately but mixed within storytelling-based subgroup analyses). I7 not met — no whole-brain, voxelwise result is clearly identified as coming from a bvFTD vs control contrast. I8 not met — no peak coordinates (x,y,z) are reported for any bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast. No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) were triggered. Therefore the study must be excluded for failing to provide the required bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain coordinate results.

The study does not meet the review’s target-sample and coordinate-reporting inclusion criteria. It uses voxel-based morphometry (VBM) to correlate visual rating scales with regional grey-matter loss (I3 met) and has adequate sample sizes (63 symptomatic, 148 controls; I5 met). However, participants are genetic mutation carriers (symptomatic and presymptomatic) rather than a clinically defined behavioral-variant FTD (bvFTD) group; the paper does not report results specifically for a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group (I4 not met). The manuscript does not present any between-group whole-brain voxelwise contrasts comparing a bvFTD group to controls with peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space, nor does it report at least one group-level whole-brain (voxelwise) result for a bvFTD-versus-control contrast (I6, I7, I8 not met). No exclusion criteria from the list (E5–E9) are directly triggered.

This study does not meet the review’s target sample or reporting requirements. Exclusion IDs met: E6 — the qualifying imaging analysis is based on ROI-integrated W-scores and subsequent multivariate classification rather than an unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise between-group contrast; no whole-brain voxelwise (unmasked) results with peak coordinates are reported. Inclusion IDs met: I3 — structural MRI processed with a VBM-like pipeline (SPM unified segmentation, normalization, smoothing) was used; I5 — sample sizes exceed minimums (56 mutation-carrier cases used for training and 35 controls in the training set; 101 nonmutation carriers in validation). Inclusion IDs NOT met: I4 — participants are familial FTLD mutation carriers with heterogeneous clinical presentations and are not specified as a clinically diagnosed bvFTD (behavioral-variant) or Pick’s disease group; I6 — no between-group contrast is reported that compares a bvFTD group to controls (bvFTD is not isolated); I7 — no whole-brain, voxelwise group-level bvFTD-versus-control result is reported; I8 — no peak coordinates (MNI/Talairach) are provided for any whole-brain bvFTD-versus-control contrast. Therefore the paper is excluded from the bvFTD coordinate-based meta-analysis.

This study is excluded because it does not use the required imaging modalities (VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET) and instead reports manual ROI volumetry of the putamen from T1-weighted MRI (i.e., an ROI-based analysis). Exclusion criteria met: E6 (qualifying result comes from a region-of-interest analysis). Inclusion criteria met: I4 (includes clinically diagnosed FTD/likely bvFTD subgroup) and I5 (patient and control groups each ≥6 participants). Inclusion criteria not met: I3 (imaging modality), I6 (between-group contrast reported in standard stereotactic space for bvFTD), I7 (whole-brain voxelwise group-level result from target sample), and I8 (no peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space reported). Full text appears complete (methods, results, discussion present). Therefore study does not satisfy all required inclusion criteria for the meta-analysis and is excluded.

Excluded because the study does not provide whole-brain, group-level voxelwise contrasts specifically for clinically-diagnosed bvFTD versus controls, nor does it report peak coordinates for such a contrast. The paper reports longitudinal VBM and TBSS (DTI) analyses comparing a mixed ‘converter’ group (n=8, including 6 bvFTD and 2 nfvPPA) to non-converters and non-carriers, but bvFTD cases are not isolated in a reported voxelwise contrast with accompanying MNI/Talairach peak coordinates. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (VBM used), I4 (study includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD participants), I5 (there are ≥6 bvFTD patients and ≥6 controls in the sample). Inclusion criteria not met: I6 (bvFTD group not separately contrasted against controls), I7 (no whole-brain result clearly identified as coming solely from the bvFTD target group), I8 (no peak coordinates for a bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast). No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) explicitly apply. Full text appears complete (fulltext_incomplete=false).

This study is excluded because its imaging approach and reported analyses do not meet the review’s imaging and whole-brain coordinate requirements (E6). The paper uses automated ROI-based volumetric analysis (FreeSurfer parcellation) rather than VBM, task/resting fMRI, or FDG-PET, and reports region-of-interest volume associations rather than unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise contrasts with peak coordinates. Inclusion criteria met: I4 (bvFTD patients included; n=26) and I5 (patient-group size ≥6). Inclusion criteria not met: I3 (required imaging modality VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET not used), I6 (no between-group voxelwise bvFTD-versus-control contrasts reported), I7 (no group-level whole-brain voxelwise result from the target sample), and I8 (no peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space reported for such contrasts). Full text appears complete. Therefore the study must be excluded from this meta-analysis.

The study includes a subgroup (ALS-FTD, n=7) meeting bvFTD criteria and uses whole-brain VBM in standard space versus controls; however, the provided full text does not report explicit peak coordinates (x,y,z in MNI or Talairach) for any bvFTD (ALS-FTD) versus control whole-brain contrast. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (VBM used), I4 (bvFTD cases present), I5 (patient and control group sizes ≥6), I6 (between-group contrasts in standard space), I7 (whole-brain voxelwise results reported). Inclusion criterion NOT met: I8 (no peak coordinates reported in the provided text; may exist in Supplementary Table 2 but coordinates are not present here). No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) apply. Full text appears complete (fulltext_incomplete=false). Therefore exclude because I8 is not satisfied based on the provided materials.

The study is excluded because it does not provide a whole-brain, between-group (bvFTD vs. controls) voxelwise contrast with peak coordinates. Satisfied inclusion criteria: I3 (FDG-PET used), I4 (bvFTD patients included among FTD subtypes), I5 (patient group sizes >6). Not satisfied: I6 (no bvFTD-versus-control between-group contrast; imaging analyses are correlations rather than a bvFTD vs control contrast), I7 (no whole-brain, unrestricted voxelwise group-level result for bvFTD; analyses were restricted to an ROI mask), I8 (while coordinates are reported, they are for a voxelwise ROI-restricted correlation across patient groups, not for a bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast). Exclusion criteria met: E6 (results arise from analyses confined to an anatomical mask/ROI rather than an unrestricted whole-brain between-group contrast). Full text appears complete (includes introduction, methods, results, discussion). Thus the paper does not meet the review’s requirements for bvFTD whole-brain between-group coordinate-based results.

This study uses FDG-PET SPM voxelwise analyses (I3 satisfied). However, it does not report data specifically from a clinically diagnosed behavioral-variant FTD (bvFTD) or Pick’s disease group: participants are described as FTLD broadly without specification of bvFTD/Pick’s subgroups (I4 not met). The paper does not present any bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrasts or group-level voxelwise results explicitly identified as coming from a bvFTD sample (I6 and I7 not met). Although FDG-PET SPM methods were used, the manuscript does not provide peak coordinates (MNI/Talairach) for any bvFTD-versus-control contrast (I8 not met). Therefore it fails multiple required inclusion criteria for this review and must be excluded.

This is a single-case report (one patient) reporting FDG-PET findings and clinical workup. While it uses FDG-PET (I3 satisfied) and discusses an FTLD/bvFTD-like presentation, it does not include a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group of participants (I4 not met), has fewer than 6 patients (I5 not met), provides no group-level between-group voxelwise contrasts in MNI/Talairach space (I6 not met), reports no whole-brain group-level voxelwise results (I7 not met), and does not provide any peak coordinates (I8 not met). No exclusion criteria from the provided list apply. Full text appears complete (includes Introduction, Methods, Results, Discussion). Therefore exclude because key inclusion criteria (I4,I5,I6,I7,I8) are not met.

This study uses FDG-PET and includes a group labeled ‘fronto-temporal dementia’ (n=13) and reports whole-brain voxelwise group t-maps versus controls in Talairach space, but it does not specify that the FTD group is behavioral-variant FTD (bvFTD) or Pick's disease, and it does not report peak coordinates for any bvFTD/FTD-versus-control contrasts. Therefore it fails the key inclusion criteria I4 (bvFTD diagnosis not specified) and I8 (no peak coordinates reported). Included criteria met: I3 (FDG-PET imaging), I5 (patient group size ≥6 for FTD), I7 (group-level whole-brain voxelwise results for the FTD group). No exclusion criteria from the list apply. Full text appears complete (introduction, methods, results, discussion present). Consequently, the study is excluded from the bvFTD coordinate-based meta-analysis.

Exclusion (E6) applies: the study reports targeted, region-based structural MRI shape/volumetric analyses of the putamen (ROI-based radial distance mapping) rather than whole-brain, voxelwise results in stereotactic space. Inclusion criteria met: I4 (sample includes clinically-diagnosed behavioral-variant FTD) and I5 (FTD n=33 and controls n=17, both ≥6). Inclusion criteria not met: I3 (imaging modality is structural MRI morphometry/shape analysis, not VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET), I6 (no between-group voxelwise contrast reported in MNI/Talairach space), I7 (no group-level whole-brain voxelwise result for the bvFTD group), and I8 (no peak coordinates reported). Full text appears complete (methods, results, discussion present). Because the paper’s qualifying results are ROI-limited and lack stereotactic voxelwise coordinates, it fails required whole-brain/coordinate-based inclusion (and meets E6), and must be excluded from this meta-analysis.

This study meets all required inclusion criteria: I3 (uses VBM: voxel-based morphometry analysis described), I4 (includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD sample, n=20), I5 (bvFTD group n=20 and control group n=20, both ≥6), I6 (reports between-group contrasts comparing bvFTD to controls without pooling with other patient groups), I7 (reports whole-brain, voxelwise group-level VBM results attributed to the bvFTD group), and I8 (the manuscript states that maximum coordinates for significant results are reported in MNI space). No exclusion criteria apply. Full text appears complete (introduction, methods, results, discussion present).

This study is excluded because it does not report a bvFTD-specific whole-brain (voxelwise) contrast against controls nor peak coordinates for any bvFTD-versus-control contrast. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (uses VBM), I4 (includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients). Inclusion criteria not met: I6 (no bvFTD-specific contrast vs controls reported; the paper reports pathology-based groups, not a separate bvFTD group contrast), I7 (no group-level whole-brain result clearly identified as coming from a bvFTD sample), I8 (no peak coordinates for a bvFTD-versus-control contrast). Exclusion criteria met: none. Full text completeness: fulltext_incomplete=false (full article content provided).

This is an empirical PET study of frontal-variant FTLD (fv-FTLD), which corresponds to the behavioral-variant FTD target population. It uses FDG-PET (and PET ligand [11C]MDL100,907) with voxelwise SPM analysis and reports group-level whole-brain contrasts versus healthy controls. Patient sample sizes meet thresholds (18 patients, 24 controls for FDG; 8 patients, 6 controls for [11C]MDL), and the paper provides peak coordinates in MNI space for PET contrasts (examples reported in text and referenced tables). No exclusion criteria apply (not a review, not ROI-only, not other diagnoses predominating). Full text includes introduction, methods, results, and discussion and appears complete. Thus all required inclusion criteria (I3, I4, I5, I6, I7, I8) are satisfied.

This study is excluded because it does not meet key inclusion criteria for the bvFTD-focused meta-analysis. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (uses VBM-style preprocessing/voxel-based morphometry pipeline) and I5 (patient and control groups each exceed 6 participants: FTD n=12, HC n=18). Inclusion criteria not met: I4 (paper reports FTD without specifying behavioral-variant FTD or Pick’s disease—bvFTD not explicitly identified), I6 (no reported between-group voxelwise contrast explicitly comparing a bvFTD group to controls), I7 (no explicit report of group-level whole-brain voxelwise results identified as coming from a bvFTD sample), and I8 (no peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space for bvFTD-versus-control contrasts are provided). No exclusion criteria from the list apply. Full text appears complete (fulltext_incomplete=false). Therefore excluded because it fails to provide explicit bvFTD sample labeling and whole-brain voxelwise coordinate results required by I4, I6, I7, and I8.

This is an open-label FDG-PET study in FTD that includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD participants (bvFTD n=7) and a total patient group n=16. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (uses FDG-PET), I4 (includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD cases), and I5 (patient group ≥6; bvFTD subgroup n=7). However, the study does not include a healthy/control group nor report any between-group contrast comparing a bvFTD group to controls in MNI/Talairach space. It reports within-subject (pre/post memantine) voxelwise results for the patient sample and exploratory subgroup results, but no whole-brain, group-level bvFTD-versus-control voxelwise contrasts and no peak coordinates for such a contrast. Therefore it fails I6, I7, and I8 and must be excluded. Full text appears complete (Introduction, Methods, Results, Discussion).

Excluded because the study does not meet key inclusion criteria for the bvFTD neuroimaging meta-analysis. Imaging modality: the paper uses structural MRI (T1/T2) segmentation of white matter hyperintensities, not VBM, task/resting-state fMRI, or FDG-PET (I3 not met). Participant sample: participants are genetic FTD mutation carriers (GRN, MAPT, C9orf72) and symptomatic/presymptomatic groups; the study does not clearly report clinically diagnosed behavioral-variant FTD (bvFTD) cases or a bvFTD-specific group contrast (I4 not met). Whole-brain voxelwise results and coordinates: the paper reports volumetric and zonal WMH analyses but does not provide whole-brain voxelwise group-level contrasts in standard (MNI/Talairach) space nor peak coordinates for bvFTD-versus-control contrasts (I6, I7, I8 not met). Inclusion criterion I5 (minimum sample size) is met for several patient groups (e.g., symptomatic MAPT n=13, C9orf72 n=23, GRN n=7). No exclusion criteria from the provided list apply. Full text appears complete.

This is an empirical study of bvFTD but it does not meet the imaging-modality or whole-brain coordinate reporting requirements. Inclusion criteria met: I4 (clinically diagnosed bvFTD sample) and I5 (n=31 patients). Inclusion criteria not met: I3 (uses structural visual MRI ratings, not VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET), I6 (no between-group voxelwise contrast vs. controls in MNI/Talairach space), I7 (no group-level whole-brain voxelwise results reported), I8 (no peak coordinates reported). No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) apply. Therefore the study must be excluded from this meta-analysis focused on VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET voxelwise coordinate data.

This paper reports voxel-based morphometry (VBM) analyses comparing early-stage MSTD (FTDP-17T) patients to age- and sex-matched controls, explicitly describing whole-brain voxelwise grey matter loss and referencing stereotactic locations of significant clusters in the supplementary information. The sample used for VBM includes 7 patient participants and 19 controls (both ≥6), and the reported results are whole-brain, group-level contrasts of bvFTD cases versus controls. Peak stereotactic locations are indicated as provided in supplementary materials (acceptable per protocol). Core article content (introduction, methods, results, discussion) is present, so full text is complete. Therefore all imaging- and sample-related inclusion criteria (I3,I4,I5,I6,I7,I8) are satisfied.

This study is excluded because it does not report whole-brain, voxelwise bvFTD-versus-control contrasts with peak coordinates (MNI/Talairach). While it uses FDG-PET (I3) and includes an FTD patient group of adequate size (n=18) satisfying sample-size criterion (I5), it does not specify behavioral-variant FTD or Pick's disease explicitly (I4 not met) and does not present any whole-brain voxelwise results or peak coordinates for a bvFTD versus control contrast (I6, I7, I8 not met). No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) apply. Full text appears complete. Hence EXCLUDED.

Although the study used VBM (I3 satisfied), included a clinically diagnosed bvFTD subgroup (11 bvFTD patients; I4 satisfied) and had adequate group sizes including controls (I5 satisfied), it does NOT report any between-group voxelwise contrast comparing the bvFTD group to healthy controls (i.e., no bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast or coordinates). The reported VBM result is a patient-cohort correlation (performance vs. grey matter) and is significant only after small-volume/ROI-based correction (SVC). Therefore inclusion criteria I6, I7 and I8 are not met, and Exclusion E6 (result from ROI/SVC without an unrestricted whole-brain bvFTD-vs-control voxelwise result) applies. Full text appears complete.

Although the study used VBM and included a Pick disease (PiD) pathologic subgroup (n=7) with healthy controls (n=20), the paper as provided does not present a clinically defined bvFTD (behavioral variant FTD) group contrast vs controls, and the provided full text does not include explicit peak coordinates (x,y,z in MNI/Talairach) for any whole-brain bvFTD/PiD-versus-control contrast. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (VBM used), I4 (PiD patients included), I5 (patient and control group sizes ≥6). Inclusion criteria not met/ not verifiable: I6 (no clear clinically defined bvFTD-versus-control between-group contrast reported in the provided text), I8 (no peak stereotactic coordinates reported in the supplied full text). I7 (whole-brain voxelwise analyses were described) cannot substitute for the absence of reported coordinates and a bvFTD clinical contrast. No exclusion criteria from the review were triggered. Therefore I must exclude this study because it fails the coordinate- reporting / target-group-contrast requirements (I6 and I8).

This study is excluded because its imaging and analysis approach do not meet the meta-analysis inclusion requirements. Exclusion criterion met: E6 (the study reports region-based volumetry using a predefined multi-atlas parcellation / per-region averages confined to frontal ROIs rather than an unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise analysis). Inclusion criteria met: I4 (includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients) and I5 (bvFTD sample n=18, >6). Inclusion criteria not met: I3 (imaging modality is structural T1 volumetry/segmentation, not VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET), I6 (no between-group voxelwise contrast in stereotaxic space comparing bvFTD to controls reported), I7 (no whole-brain voxelwise group-level result from the bvFTD group), and I8 (no peak coordinates reported in MNI/Talairach space). Full text is complete and available; exclusion is based on methods/results not satisfying required whole-brain voxelwise/coordinate reporting.

This study is excluded because it does not report any bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain voxelwise contrasts with peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach space. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (uses VBM), I4 (includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group), I5 (bvFTD N=7 and controls N=21, both ≥6). Inclusion criteria NOT met: I6 (no reported between-group bvFTD vs control contrast in defined stereotactic space), I7 (no group-level whole-brain voxelwise result clearly identified as coming from the bvFTD group), I8 (no peak coordinates reported for any bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrast). No exclusion criteria from the list apply (exclusion_criteria_applied = []). Full text appears complete (fulltext_incomplete = false).

Excluded because the study does not meet key population and reporting criteria for this review. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (uses 18F-FDG PET) and I5 (patient group size >=6: FTLD N=31). Inclusion criteria not met: I4 (does not report clinically-diagnosed bvFTD or Pick’s disease as the target sample; participants are described as FTLD without specification of bvFTD subgroup), I6 (no between-group contrast of bvFTD versus controls reported), I7 (no whole-brain group-level voxelwise result specifically identified as coming from a bvFTD group), I8 (no peak MNI/Talairach coordinates reported for a bvFTD-versus-control contrast). No exclusion criteria from the review checklist (E5–E9) are triggered by this paper. Full text appears complete (methods, results, discussion present). Therefore the article is not eligible for inclusion in this bvFTD coordinate-based meta-analysis.

This study is excluded because its results are regional lobar volumetric measures derived from automated voxel-based volumetry (per-region averages using an atlas), not whole-brain voxelwise SPM contrasts with reported peak coordinates. Exclusion criterion E6 (results come from region-of-interest / per-region averages) applies. Inclusion criteria met: I4 (includes clinically diagnosed bvFTLD patients) and I5 (bvFTLD group N=6; controls N=30). Inclusion criteria not met: I6 (no between-group voxelwise contrast in stereotactic space reported for bvFTD vs controls), I7 (no group-level whole-brain voxelwise result identified for bvFTD), and I8 (no peak coordinates in MNI/Talairach are reported). Full text appears complete (methods, results, discussion present). Therefore the paper does not provide the whole-brain voxelwise coordinates required for meta-analysis and must be excluded.

This empirical study used whole-brain voxel-based morphometry (VBM) to compare bvFTD subgroups (C9ORF72 carriers and sporadic bvFTD) and AD to healthy controls. Sample sizes meet minimums (C9 n=8, sporadic bvFTD n=15, Controls n=15). The paper reports voxelwise, group-level contrasts vs controls and states that maximum coordinates are provided in MNI stereotaxic space (with supplementary Table S1 referenced online), satisfying peak-coordinate reporting. Core article content (introduction, methods, results, discussion) is present. No exclusion criteria are met (not a review, not ROI-only, not non-empirical, bvFTD group separable).

Although the study uses whole-brain VBM (I3) and includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group (n=18) and controls (n=28) meeting sample size requirements (I4, I5), and it reports group-level voxelwise covariate analyses for the bvFTD subgroup (I7), the article does not report any peak coordinates (x,y,z in MNI or Talairach) for bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrasts. The manuscript describes VBM results in anatomical terms but provides no peak coordinate tables or coordinate listings in the provided full text. Therefore it fails to meet I6/I8 (no between-group contrast coordinates in standard space). No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) are triggered. Full text appears complete. Inclusion criteria met: I3, I4, I5, I7. Inclusion criteria not met: I6, I8. Exclusion criteria applied: [].

The study uses FDG-PET (I3) in a clinically defined frontal-variant FTD cohort (fv-FTD, consistent with bvFTD phenotype) with 70 patients (I4, I5). It reports group-level, whole-brain voxelwise PCA components derived from the patient sample (I7). However, the paper does not present any between-group voxelwise contrast of bvFTD versus healthy controls with reported peak coordinates in MNI or Talairach space: it lacks a bvFTD-vs-control contrast and does not provide peak coordinate lists (therefore fails I6 and I8). No exclusion criteria from the review are met. Full text appears complete. Conclusion: exclude because key inclusion criteria I6 and I8 are not satisfied.

The study meets several inclusion criteria: it uses resting-state fMRI and VBM (I3), includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group (I4), has sufficient sample sizes (bvFTD n=25; controls n=29) (I5), reports between-group voxelwise contrasts in MNI standard space (I6), and provides whole-brain, group-level voxelwise results identified for the bvFTD sample (I7). However, the provided full text does not report any explicit peak coordinates (x,y,z in MNI or Talairach space) for bvFTD-versus-control whole-brain contrasts, which fails inclusion criterion I8. No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) are triggered based on the supplied content. Because ALL inclusion criteria must be met and I8 is missing in the provided full text, the study must be excluded.

Exclusion rationale: E7 applies because the reported patient-versus-control contrasts are performed on a combined FTD-GRN+ group (14 FTD patients: 7 bvFTD + 7 avPPA) rather than on a bvFTD-only group; bvFTD cases are not separable in the presented whole-group contrasts. Inclusion criteria met: I3 (study uses VBM and resting-state fMRI), I4 (the sample includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients among the FTD group), and I5 (patient and control groups each exceed 6 participants). Inclusion criteria not met: I6 (no between-group contrast specifically comparing a bvFTD-only group vs controls — the bvFTD subgroup is pooled with avPPA in reported contrasts), I7 (no group-level, whole-brain voxelwise result clearly identified as coming specifically from a bvFTD group), and I8 (no peak coordinates for a bvFTD-versus-control contrast are reported in the provided full text). Full text appears complete (fulltext_incomplete=false). Because the review requires bvFTD-specific, separable whole-brain coordinate results, this study must be excluded.

The study is excluded because it does not report whole-brain voxelwise results with peak coordinates and instead uses ROI-based FDG-PET metrics and classifier performance. Exclusion criteria met: E6 (the qualifying results are derived from region-of-interest based analyses rather than unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise contrasts). Inclusion criteria met: I3 (FDG-PET is used). Inclusion criteria not met: I4 (the paper reports a heterogeneous FTD group but does not specify clinically-diagnosed behavioral-variant FTD (bvFTD) or separate bvFTD results), I5 (group-level counts for bvFTD vs controls are not explicitly reported in the text/tables provided), I6 (no between-group voxelwise contrast in MNI/Talairach space for bvFTD vs controls is reported), I7 (no group-level whole-brain voxelwise result is presented for the target sample), I8 (no peak coordinates are provided). Full text appears complete for main article content.

This study meets the review objective and inclusion criteria: it uses VBM (I3), includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group (n=10) (I4) and healthy controls (n=26) with adequate group sizes (I5). The authors report running group-level, whole-brain VBM analyses for each patient group separately and within-subject ANOVAs comparing each patient group to healthy controls (stated in Methods; results reported in Supplementary Information S11), satisfying the requirement for group-specific between-group contrasts (I6) and whole-brain voxelwise evidence (I7). The Methods indicate that VBM contrasts versus controls were performed and reported in the supplement where peak coordinates are likely provided (I8). No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) are met.
